info.title: Inspecto Control API — v1
info.description: The v1 business-contract surface of the Inspecto control plane (design of record: docs/okf/product/module/processor/plan-control-api.md; provenance: docs/archived-documents/plans-archive/api-contract-design.md; transport spine: W1, shipped 2026-07-06). Contract policy: ADDITIVE ONLY within v1 — never remove or rename a field; deprecations are announced via metadata.warnings with a sunset date. Every response uses the Envelope (success) or ErrorResponse (non-2xx) shape; every request/response carries a Correlation-ID header (issued by the server when the caller sends none). Since API-5 (2026-07-25) /api/v1 is the ONLY business surface (the unversioned routes and their sunset apparatus were deleted); this document covers the as-built exemplar paths, not the whole route table; this document grows per bounded context (see tags) as each context's DTO contract is formalized (worklog W3+). Paths documented here are the as-built exemplars that the contract test (inspecto/src/test/java/com/gamma/control/ApiContractTest.java) pins against the live server. Vendor extension x-probe {path, status} marks a GET operation the contract test executes live.

servers.description: Versioned surface (v1 envelope + structured errors). Basic: plain HTTP, localhost. Standard and Advanced: HTTPS behind the WSO2 gateway with OIDC (Keycloak/IAM) — same contract.

200.description: Manifests of the hosted Spaces, sorted by id. A closed Space (admission: closed) is listed only to a caller it admits: its creator, a holder of canAdminister, or a holder of a role its own role table defines; with no sign-in every Space is listed.

post.summary: Create a Space, optionally seeded from a Space Template
post.description: Body {id, display_name?, description?, template?, loadSamples?, path?, dataRoot?}. path (SPACE-LOCATIONS-1) is a Space folder named <id>, absent or empty, kept outside the Spaces root: the Space is created there and <spaces root>/<id>.ref written; dataRoot is a data folder, absent or empty, written as data_root before the Space starts (a template's samples go there). Either needs the launch setting spaces.allowed.roots (409 SPACE_LOCATIONS_DISABLED), is 422 when malformed or path is not named <id>, 403 outside the allowed folders, 409 when a check of POST /spaces/_locations/check fails. loadSamples: true (LA-ONBOARD-1 OB-12) copies the template's data/samples/<pipeline>/ files into that Pipeline's inbox and runs every Pipeline that then has files waiting, once, and answers samples.pipelines[] = {pipeline, sampleFiles, status: loaded|failed, filesLoaded, filesQuarantined, error?} beside the manifest; the Space stays created whatever a run answers. loadSamples without a template, or with a template that ships no samples (GET /spaces/templates samples: false), is refused 422 and nothing is created. Requires canAdminister, the zero-Space recovery create included (there the IdP admin role resolves through the seeded roles; TEMPLATE-RECOVERY-IMPORT-GATE-1). A template's carried kinds meet the same capability table as /spaces/import; a KPI pack (config/registry/kpis/) also needs canAuthorWorkbench, and each KPI meets the /components/kpi save gate against the template's own Datasets; the first refusal creates no Space (ASSURE-KPI-DEFINITIONS-RESIDUALS-1). A signed-in caller is recorded as the Space's creator and the Space is created closed (answer: admission closed, createdBy): every route under /spaces/{id}/ then answers 404 'no such space' to anyone but the creator, a holder of canAdminister and a holder of a role the Space's own role table defines (PUT /access/roles in that Space admits a role). With no sign-in nothing is recorded and the Space is open.

200.description: The created Space manifest (id, displayName, description).

403.description: canAdminister missing on a populated server, or a template KPI pack without canAuthorWorkbench; nothing was created.

422.description: A template KPI refused by the /components/kpi save gate (unknown or shared-away Dataset, a field or timeField not in its Schema, a timeField that is not a date), or loadSamples without a template or with a template that ships no samples; nothing was created.

get.summary: Declarative spec for a config type
get.description: The metadata that drives form rendering and validation for one config type (metadata-first, guideline 4/14). Folds into the bootstrap payload with W3.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Config type (e.g. pipeline, job, schema, enrichment, meta).

200.description: The spec (field descriptors, groups, validation). Shape tightens with the W3 metadata contract.

data.description: ConfigSpec — as-built shape, formalized in W3.

post.summary: Validate a config file or draft

schema.description: Either {configPath} (a file on the server, under the allowed roots — absolute, or relative to the write root) or {type, config} (an unsaved draft map); optional {safety:true} adds the hard-fail safety gate. COMPONENT-VALIDATE-ALL-1: type may also be kpi, reconciliation, dataset, widget or dashboard (optional id names the draft): the draft is judged by the checks its POST /components/{type} save runs (shape, a KPI's Dataset and fields, a virtual Dataset's SQL safety check, unknown keys: an error for an agent Subject, a warning otherwise), writing and holding nothing.

200.description: Validation outcome — findings, never an HTTP error for a merely-invalid draft.

post.description: The exemplar of the shared fail-closed write-gate chain (WriteGates): write-root 503 CONTROL_PLANE_READ_ONLY → malformed body 400 → unsafe name 422 → path jail 403 → overwrite conflict 409 → atomic write.

subdir.description: Optional subdirectory under the write root (must stay inside — path jail).

file.description: type=schema only: the file's base name (no extension, no separators — an unsafe name 422s), decoupled from the schema's raw.name so the file written is the <pipeline>_schema.toon a Pipeline references (SCHEMA-FILE-NAME-1). Absent ⇒ named by raw.name. Any other type sending it is 400.

200.description: Written atomically under the write root.

post.summary: Parse a raw sample with a draft's parsing settings
post.description: Stateless, scratch-only sample preview (v5.1.0, stream onboarding's raw→parsed hop): the pipeline draft map is interpreted by the real config parser and the sample is read with the same DuckDB idioms the ingest engine uses (delimited dialect, fixed-width slices, read_json, regexp named groups). Schema-less by design — this is the parse step, before names/types attach. Plugin ingesters and binary fixed-width records are not previewable (422). Config or parse problems return 422 with the reason.

config.description: A full pipeline draft map (the same shape POST /validate takes).

post.summary: TRY_CAST already-parsed sample rows against a draft schema's typed fields
post.description: Stateless, scratch-only preview (v5.2.0, stream onboarding's Schema & Mapping stage — the parsed→typed hop). Reuses the Studio schema component's own preview (ComponentPreview#schema): each declared field's value is TRY_CAST to its type, splitting rows into ok / rejected. Config or cast problems return 422 with the reason.

config.description: A schema draft map, e.g. {raw:{fields:[{name,type}]}} (the same shape POST /config/write type=schema accepts).

sampleRows.description: Already-parsed sample rows (e.g. a ParsingPreviewResult's rows) to cast-check.

get.description: Returns one config .toon under the write root as its decoded map — the stream-onboarding resume path (v5.1.0): the guided editor reopens a draft from server state. Same resolution and gate chain as DELETE: write-root 503 CONTROL_PLANE_READ_ONLY → unknown type 404 → unsafe name 422 → subdir path jail 403 → missing file 404.

parameters.description: A /config/spec type (pipeline, enrichment, job, schema, meta, alert, expectation).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The config's identity-derived filename (without .toon).

parameters.name: subdir
parameters.description: Optional subdirectory under the write root (must stay inside — path jail); mirrors /config/write.

delete.description: Deletes one config .toon under the write root — the stream-onboarding draft-discard path (v5.1.0). Same fail-closed gate chain as /config/write: write-root 503 CONTROL_PLANE_READ_ONLY → unknown type 404 → unsafe name 422 → subdir path jail 403 → missing file 404 → active pipeline 409 → single atomic delete. An active:true pipeline is never deleted — deactivate it first.

200.description: All Connection profiles. Secrets are ALWAYS masked ('***') on the wire — the mask sentinel round-trips on update to preserve stored references.

put.description: Masked secret sentinels ('***') in the body preserve the stored secret references.

post.description: TCP reachability + secret resolution — a business capability, not CRUD.

data.description: ConnectionTester result — as-built shape, formalized with the Acquisition context.

get.summary: Platform bootstrap — everything the backend owns to start the UI
get.description: One cached, ETag'd call folding edition + feature flags, every config spec, the platform enumerations, the Space list and a session stub (design §6.1) — replacing today's N× config-spec + /spaces round-trips. The ComponentKind / Visualization-Type / $-parameter registries and theme stay compile-time in the SPA (documented boundary — the backend has no authority over them). If-None-Match yields 304.
A versioned metadata resource (W3): the response carries a strong ETag = the content hash; a matching If-None-Match yields 304.

put.description: Optimistic locking (W3): an If-Match precondition against the current content hash yields 409 CONFLICT_STALE_VERSION on a stale write. The new ETag rides the 200 response.

schema.description: The component config (the routing-only 'id' key is ignored).

delete.description: Safe-deletes one component of the kind in the path. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench; a kind with its own route (alert-rule, findings-spec) also needs that route's capability and a dedicated-only kind is refused 403. 503 when the control plane is read-only; 400 for a bad kind; 404 for an unknown component; 409 when a Pipeline references it, it is shared with other Spaces, an Alert Rule links the runbook or Mappings read the Dataset.

post.description: Executes a query component's SQL against its dataset in a DuckDB sandbox (W4, design §6.2): server-side $-parameter resolution (built-ins + declared defaults + caller overrides), SqlGuard safety gate, dataset→relation resolution, and the full Result Set contract. Results are transactional and never cached (no ETag). Only type:sql runs server-side today; structured queries compile to SQL client-side.

Fires a job off the request thread and returns 202 + the runId + a Location to poll (design §7 / §10 W5). Accepts an Idempotency-Key so a retried trigger returns the same runId without a second run. The legacy unversioned route keeps its 200 {job,status:'triggered'} body.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: Attributes the manual fire (recorded as manual:<actor>).

get.description: The status of a run started by POST /jobs/{name}/trigger (W5): RUNNING until the job finishes, then a terminal status. 404 once evicted from the bounded live-run registry (durable history stays at /jobs/{name}/runs).

post.summary: Redeem an OIDC authorization code (backend-mediated session)
post.description: W6d: the SPA completes Authorization Code + PKCE in the browser, then posts the one-time code here. The backend redeems it against the IAM's token endpoint server-to-server and keeps the refresh token in an httpOnly + SameSite=Strict cookie (inspecto_rt) the page's JavaScript can never read — only the short-lived access token is returned. Public route (a caller redeeming a code has no Bearer token yet); cross-site calls are rejected when -Dauth.origin (or -Dcontrol.cors) is configured. 503 on Basic (no session broker).

200.description: Session established; the refresh cookie rides Set-Cookie.

post.summary: Mint a fresh access token from the session cookie
post.description: Reads the httpOnly refresh cookie, redeems it at the IAM, rotates the cookie, and returns the new access token. A rejected (expired/revoked) session is a 401 with the cookie cleared. 503 on Basic.

200.description: Fresh access token; the rotated refresh cookie rides Set-Cookie.

post.description: Best-effort revocation of the refresh token at the IAM, then clears the session cookies. The optional body {postLogoutRedirectUri} is placed on the end-session URL returned as endSessionUrl. Idempotent — succeeds with or without a live session. 503 on Basic.

200.description: Session ended; the cleared cookie rides Set-Cookie.

endSessionUrl.description: The provider's end-session URL carrying id_token_hint, client_id and post_logout_redirect_uri; present only when the session held an ID token and the provider has an end-session endpoint.

get.description: Health of each subsystem (configStore and dataStore directories, Pipelines, Jobs and more) and the Spaces skipped at boot with their reasons; deeper than the public /health probe and not a public path, so it needs an authenticated request. No capability gate.

Answers READY with the loaded Pipeline count; zero Spaces is still ready so a Space can be created. A public, unversioned infra path that needs no credentials. No capability gate. 503 when Spaces are configured but none booted.
Serves the API contract, byte-equal to docs/api/openapi-v1.json, loaded lazily on the first request. Authenticated like the rest of /api/v1. No capability gate.

Answers {multiSpace, locationsEnabled}: whether this server can create, edit and delete Spaces, so the UI need not infer it from the Space list; and whether the launch setting spaces.allowed.roots is set, so the Space folder and data folder routes work (SPACE-LOCATIONS-1). No capability gate.
The Space Template gallery; an empty list on a single-Space server. No capability gate.

post.summary: Create a Space from a bundle zip
post.description: The request body is a bundle zip and ?id= names the new Space, which is created and booted from it; each config kind the bundle carries must pass its own route's capability check. Gated on canAdminister. 409 on a single-Space server or when the id or directory exists; 400 for a missing or invalid id or a bad bundle; 422 for an unknown classification.

put.description: Body {display_name?, description?}; the Space id and folder are immutable. Gated on canAdminister. 409 on a single-Space server; 400 for an invalid id or the default Space; 404 for an unknown Space.

delete.description: Deregisters and drains a Space; ?purge=true also deletes its directory tree. Gated on canAdminister. 409 on a single-Space server or when purging the last Space on disk; 400 for an invalid id; 404 for an unknown Space.

post.summary: Check a Space folder or data folder
post.description: Body {path, kind: space|data, id?}; path is absolute or relative to the app root. Writes nothing. Answers {path, kind, ok, checks: [{check, ok, reason}]}, the checks in order: allowed, install, overlap, name (kind space), reachable, writable, free-space (the deploy kit MIN_FREE_GB rule, default 5), stamp (kind data), content (kind space: holds a Space or is empty; kind data: empty or already this Space). id names the Space a data folder is for. Gated on canAdminister (403); 409 on a single-Space server; 409 SPACE_LOCATIONS_DISABLED while the launch setting spaces.allowed.roots (env SPACES_ALLOWED_ROOTS) is unset; 422 for a malformed body; 403 PATH_JAIL_VIOLATION for a folder outside the allowed folders (judged after .. and links are resolved); 409 CONFLICT when a check fails (SPACE-LOCATIONS-1).

post.summary: Attach a Space folder kept outside the Spaces root
post.description: Body {path, id?}: the folder name is the Space id (id, when given, must equal it). Writes <spaces root>/<id>.ref (relative to the app root when the folder is under it) and starts the Space at once; it is started again at every restart and keeps the admission its space.toon says. Answers the Space row with location. 409 when the folder is not a Space, the id is taken, or it overlaps another Space; 422 when the Space does not start (the reference is removed). Gated on canAdminister (403); 409 on a single-Space server; 409 SPACE_LOCATIONS_DISABLED while the launch setting spaces.allowed.roots (env SPACES_ALLOWED_ROOTS) is unset; 422 for a malformed body; 403 PATH_JAIL_VIOLATION for a folder outside the allowed folders (judged after .. and links are resolved); 409 CONFLICT when a check fails (SPACE-LOCATIONS-1).

post.summary: Detach a Space kept outside the Spaces root
post.description: Stops a Space started through its <id>.ref and deletes the reference; its Space folder and data folder stay on disk and can be attached again. Answers {id, detached: true}. 404 for an unknown Space; 409 for a Space inside the Spaces root (remove it with DELETE /spaces/{id}). Gated on canAdminister (403); 409 on a single-Space server; 409 SPACE_LOCATIONS_DISABLED while the launch setting spaces.allowed.roots (env SPACES_ALLOWED_ROOTS) is unset; 422 for a malformed body; 403 PATH_JAIL_VIOLATION for a folder outside the allowed folders (judged after .. and links are resolved); 409 CONFLICT when a check fails (SPACE-LOCATIONS-1).

put.summary: Change the data folder of a Space that holds no data
put.description: Body {path} (null: back under the Space folder). Only while the Space keeps no files in data/ or audit/; its stores (duckdb/) move with it. The Space is stopped, space.toon gets data_root (relative to the app root when under it), and it is started again, which stamps the folder. Answers the Space row with location. 404 for an unknown Space; 409 SPACE_HOLDS_DATA when it holds data; 409 when the folder is not empty or belongs to another Space; 422 when it does not start (the Space is put back as it was). Gated on canAdminister (403); 409 on a single-Space server; 409 SPACE_LOCATIONS_DISABLED while the launch setting spaces.allowed.roots (env SPACES_ALLOWED_ROOTS) is unset; 422 for a malformed body; 403 PATH_JAIL_VIOLATION for a folder outside the allowed folders (judged after .. and links are resolved); 409 CONFLICT when a check fails (SPACE-LOCATIONS-1).

get.description: The Pipeline ids of this Space that can be exported as a config bundle (the path keeps the legacy word datasources). No capability gate. 503 when the control plane is read-only.
Downloads a zip of the Pipeline's config and metadata files plus a bundle.toon manifest; no ingested data. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown Pipeline; 503 when the control plane is read-only.
Downloads the Space's config tree and space.toon as a zip. It seeds a new Space and cannot be imported into an existing one. No capability gate. 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Import a config bundle into this Space
post.description: Unpacks a bundle zip (the body) into the Space's config and registers its Connections and Pipelines, all or nothing; ?on_conflict=overwrite replaces existing Pipeline ids, and a missing Connection lands its dependants disabled with a warning. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 503 when read-only; 400 for a bad bundle; 403 for a whole-Space export or a reserved file; 409 for clashing ids or an approval policy; 422 for unresolvable references.

Dry run over a bundle zip: its kind, Pipeline ids, files, id conflicts with this Space, per-Pipeline spec and safety findings and missing-Connection warnings; writes nothing. valid:true is not the full commit gate. No capability gate. 400 for a bad bundle; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

get.description: Every Pipeline the service has loaded; optional ?limit=&offset= slice the list (no limit returns all). No capability gate.

post.summary: Register a Pipeline from a config on disk
post.description: Body {configPath}, absolute or relative to the write root: the config is validated (spec, safety, schema_file) and registered in memory so it runs on the next poll cycle. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 503 when read-only; 400 without configPath; 403 for a path outside the write root; 404 when no file is there; 422 for a config with ERROR findings; 409 for an id colliding with another Pipeline.

Fires one registered pipeline. On the v1 surface returns 202 + {runId,pipeline,status,skipPostAction,dryRun} and a Location to poll; the legacy unversioned route keeps its 200 RunResult body. Response schemas are otherwise undocumented — see control-api.md §5 for the exemplar-coverage decision.

parameters.name: skipPostAction
parameters.description: Skip the source-side post-action for this fire (PIPELINE-DRYRUN-1). Acquisition still fetches from the remote collector for real, so the trigger proves the pipeline can reach and read its source; a collector.post_action.on_success of DELETE/MOVE/RENAME never touches the remote original; and the ingest write STILL HAPPENS FOR REAL. This is not a preview and not the job framework's ?dryRun=true. Renamed from ?dryRun=true on 2026-09-20. Manual triggers only — cron/event/signal fires are always real.

parameters.name: dryRun
parameters.description: Dry-run the WHOLE pipeline (PIPELINE-DRYRUN-1 step 5): the cycle lands NOTHING — no partition outputs, no quarantine or backup moves, no manifest, no markers, no audit or commit-log rows, no provenance row, no fingerprint/watermark ledger entries — and every suppressed mutation is logged as 'dry run: would ...' so an operator can read the log and see what the real run would have done. The terminal ConsignmentEvent is still published, MARKED dryRun, so a chained Job runs dry too; every other consumer (alert evaluation, the event-store bridge, event-triggered pipelines, enrichment) refuses and logs instead of acting. Choosing between the two: skipPostAction means 'fetch, but do not ack the remote source' and the ingest write still happens for real; dryRun means 'show me what would happen' and nothing happens. dryRun=true IMPLIES skipPostAction — a dry run that deleted the customer's source file is the worst failure this feature can have. Manual triggers only.

get.description: The status of one run fired by POST /runs/{name}/trigger (its Location). A finished dry run (?dryRun=true) also carries its per-record rejects (EXECUTION-RESIDUALS X4). 404 once evicted or unknown.

post.description: Pauses the Pipeline named in the path. Gated on canOperateRuns. 404 for an unknown Pipeline.
Resumes the Pipeline named in the path. Gated on canOperateRuns. 404 for an unknown Pipeline.

get.description: The committed Consignments recorded in the status store of the Pipeline named in the path. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown Pipeline.

Every Consignment row in the Pipeline's status store; a PARKED row gains parkedAt and parkedTables, and one whose branch commit log still exists gains committedBranches and sourceFinalized. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown Pipeline.
The per-file processing history from the status store of the Pipeline named in the path. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown Pipeline.
File-to-partition lineage recorded in the Pipeline's status store, optionally narrowed to one ?batchId=. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown Pipeline.
The quarantine entries recorded in the status store of the Pipeline named in the path. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown Pipeline.

Every file the Consignment named by ?consignmentId= wrote, including derived tables a post-sync step registered; enabled:false means the outputs registry is switched off, not that nothing was written, and derivedRuns lists the Runs that read it when a run store exists. No capability gate. 400 without consignmentId.

get.summary: Rejected rows behind a file's error count
get.description: Up to 500 rows of the file's companion errors CSV, found by ?file= (a bare file name) in the errors directory or the quarantine tree. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown Pipeline or when no rejected-row detail is recorded; 400 without file; 403 for a path instead of a bare name; 422 when the detail cannot be read.
The files still waiting in the Pipeline's inbox (matched, not yet processed) and whether it is ingesting now. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown Pipeline.

Where the file at ?path= (poll-relative) is now, from the durable FileStages registry; empty when the registry is off or the file predates it. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown Pipeline; 400 without path.

post.description: Body {batchId}: reprocesses that Consignment of the Pipeline named in the path. Gated on canOperateRuns. 404 for an unknown Pipeline; 409 for a template Pipeline, or for a Consignment whose output files a compaction merged away or a later arrival replaced rows of (re-ingesting would put rows in twice or bring replaced rows back; the reason names no server path); 400 without batchId.

Body {batchId}: completes a Consignment that parked at a disabled route-branch sink and returns the drained branches, output files and rows. Gated on canOperateRuns. 404 for an unknown Pipeline or a batch with no manifest; 409 for a template Pipeline or a Consignment that cannot be drained; 400 without batchId.

post.summary: Replay one file's rejected records as a new Consignment (EXECUTION-RESIDUALS X4)
post.description: canOperateRuns. Re-ingests the rejected records of ONE file, re-read from the ORIGINAL source file by the reject sidecar's line numbers (values are never stored; the sidecar keeps line, column, reason and a salted value fingerprint, plus the source's size and sha256), as a new Consignment through the normal ingest lane; the file's good records (already landed under eject-and-continue) are not touched. Idempotent per sidecar: a second replay of the same sidecar is 409. 404 unknown pipeline or no sidecar; 400 missing file; 403 a path instead of a bare name; 409 template, already replayed, or the source file changed since its rejects were recorded; 410 the source file is gone; 422 not replayable (non-CSV frontend, no source columns, possibly truncated by rejects_limit). A replay whose Consignment did not complete returns 200 with status FAILED and releases its claim.

file.description: The input file's bare name, as the Files or Quarantine tab shows it

default.description: Envelope-wrapped {pipeline, file, replayFile, batchId, status, records, outputRows, errorRows, error}.

get.summary: List one pipeline's pending COMMIT retries (X1 deferrals)
get.description: Open read. The files waiting on a bounded COMMIT retry, by poll-relative path: attempts, firstFailedAt, lastFailedAt, nextRetryAt, due, lastError, inInbox, readable. keepsRetryState=false means the pipeline has no dirs.status_dir and keeps NO retry state (a failed Consignment is retried every cycle without bound) — not the same answer as an empty list. Bounded by ?limit= (max 500) with truncated + the true total; an unreadable record is listed with readable=false, never a 500. 404 unknown pipeline; 400 a non-integer or negative limit.

default.description: Envelope-wrapped {pipeline, keepsRetryState, note?, policy:{maxAttempts, initialBackoffMs, maxBackoffMs, bounded}, total, truncated, retries[], error?}.

post.summary: Retry one file's COMMIT on the next cycle (X1 deferrals)
post.description: canOperateRuns. Clears the file's backoff ONLY; the attempt count is kept (the response says so), so the cap still bites. Taken under the pipeline's run claim without blocking. 404 unknown pipeline, no retry record, or the file is not in the inbox; 400 missing file; 403 an absolute path or one leaving the poll directory; 409 template, no retry state (no dirs.status_dir), already quarantined, the pipeline is mid-cycle, or the record could not be acted on.

file.description: The file's path relative to the pipeline's poll directory, as GET /runs/{runId}/retries lists it

default.description: Envelope-wrapped {pipeline, file, outcome: rescheduled, attempts, maxAttempts, attemptsKept: true, note}.

post.summary: Cancel one file's COMMIT retries: quarantine it now under retry_cancelled (X1 deferrals)
post.description: canOperateRuns. Quarantines the file NOW under reason retry_cancelled and spends its retry record — it decides the file's fate exactly as exhaustion does; it never merely drops the record (which would restore unbounded retry). Same gates and refusals as retry-now; a second cancel reports already quarantined (409) instead of appearing to act.

file.description: The file's path relative to the pipeline's poll directory, as GET /runs/{runId}/retries lists it

default.description: Envelope-wrapped {pipeline, file, outcome: cancelled, attempts, maxAttempts, quarantineReason: retry_cancelled}.

post.description: Runs every registered Pipeline once, concurrently within the global budget, and returns the total and failed counts. Gated on canOperateRuns.

get.description: The aggregated status report across the Space's Pipelines. No capability gate.

One row per FULL (quarantined) or PARTIAL (ingested with rejected rows) file across every loaded Pipeline, newest first, plus a WARNING row per unreadable ledger; ?limit= (default 1000, max 5000) and ?since= on end_time, with counts over everything. No capability gate. 400 for a non-integer or below-1 limit.
The Consignment audit rollup over all Pipelines, optionally scoped by ?from=&to= (inclusive, date or datetime). No capability gate.

get.summary: Consignment audit report of one Pipeline
get.description: The Consignment audit rollup of the Pipeline named in the path, optionally scoped by ?from=&to= (inclusive, date or datetime). No capability gate. 404 for an unknown Pipeline.

post.summary: Graded probe of a saved Connection
post.description: Body {checks?, sampleLimit?}: runs the chosen checks among reachability, authenticate, read, write and list (all five when omitted); a check the connector cannot answer comes back skipped. Gated on canOnboardConnections. 404 for an unknown Connection; 422 for an unknown check name.

get.description: The children of ?path= (the root when omitted) on a saved Connection. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown Connection or path; 501 for a connector without explore support; 403 for a path escaping the Connection's root; 422 for an invalid path; 502 on an upstream error.

get.summary: Sample a file through a Connection
get.description: A bounded preview of the file at ?path= (required), ?limit= rows (default 50, clamped to 1-500). No capability gate. 400 without path; 404 for an unknown Connection or path; 501 for a connector without sample support; 403 for a path escaping the Connection's root; 422 for an invalid path; 502 on an upstream error.

post.description: Tests the profile in the body without saving it; ?target= connection (default), tunnel or proxy picks which hop to probe. Gated on canOnboardConnections. 400 for an invalid profile; 422 for an unsupported target or a tunnel or proxy target with none configured.

get.description: Summaries of every sink.view definition a Pipeline recorded (name, Pipeline, the tables it reads, whether it has derived SQL); empty without a write root. No capability gate.
The full sink.view definition, including derived_sql. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown view; 400 for an unsafe name.

Runs the view's derived_sql and returns up to ?limit= rows (default 1000, max 10000). No capability gate. 404 for an unknown view; 400 for an unsafe name; 409 when the view has no derived_sql; 422 when the query fails.

get.summary: List the registered Pipelines, broken ones included
get.description: One row per registered Pipeline file, lifted to a graph summary. A file that does not load (PIPELINE-LOAD-FAILURE-INVISIBLE-1) is still listed, after the healthy rows, as {name, path, loadError} with no graph fields; it appears on no other surface, so nothing runs, schedules or counts it.

200.description: Healthy rows first (graph summary), then broken rows (loadError).

get.description: The catalog of node types a Pipeline graph can hold, from the Pipeline projection. No capability gate.
Every Step Processor, including undelivered ones that the palettes render inactive. No capability gate.
Every registered Pipeline lifted to its graph and projected together with the Job topology. No capability gate.
Summaries of every grandfathered authored Pipeline graph (readable and runnable, never newly written); empty without a write root. No capability gate.
The structural graph projection of one grandfathered authored Pipeline. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown authored Pipeline.

delete.description: Removes one grandfathered authored Pipeline graph. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 503 when the control plane is read-only; 404 for an unknown authored Pipeline; 422 for an invalid id; 400 when the store refuses the id.

get.description: The authored definition with every node's config, so the editor can round-trip it without dropping config. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown authored Pipeline.

post.summary: Dry-run a Pipeline over sample rows
post.description: Runs sample rows through the Pipeline's transform-to-sink subgraph on a throwaway DuckDB and returns per-node and per-sink row counts; a body pipeline key previews that candidate graph instead of the stored one. Never touches production output. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown Pipeline; 400 for a bad sample or malformed graph; 422 for a validation or SQL error.

post.summary: Run-to-here over real inbox files (scratch only)
post.description: Parses the body files (Connection-relative paths) through the real ingest path into a scratch root and previews the graph up to ?to=nodeId; never fires a production run. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 404 for an unknown Pipeline or file; 400 without files; 403 for a path escaping the Pipeline's root; 422 for a FAILED parse or preview; 501 for a Dataset-fed or non-local Collector.

Fires one real run of the authored Pipeline without a Job config and returns 202 with the runId and a Location to poll (/jobs/runs/{runId}); optional ?actor= attributes the fire. Gated on canOperateRuns. 503 when the control plane is read-only; 404 for an unknown authored Pipeline.

get.description: The registered Pipeline lifted to its graph projection, flagged readOnlyProjection with a link to the editable /graph/raw; putting this body back is refused. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown Pipeline.

put.description: Lowers the posted graph onto the Pipeline's *_pipeline.toon (the URL name wins), runs the shared save gate and writes atomically; honours If-Match against the file's content hash. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 503 when read-only; 400 for a malformed graph; 422 for validation failures, an unrepresentable topology or ERROR findings; 409 on a stale If-Match; 202 when an approval policy holds the change.

get.description: The Pipeline's config projected to Markdown (an xlsx workbook with ?format=xlsx), with an X-Config-Fingerprint header hashing the recipe and every resolved component. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown Pipeline or a missing config file.

The lossless editable graph (node configs verbatim, a node per companion enrichment) with a strong ETag for If-Match on save; a registered Pipeline that fails to load returns a repair view carrying loadError. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown Pipeline; 422 when a broken Pipeline cannot be opened for repair.

post.summary: Copy a Pipeline into a template
post.description: Body {id, name?}: writes a non-runnable template copy whose dirs, Stream, Collector id, DuckLake path and schema files are repointed into a data/templates/<id>/ sandbox, then registers it. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 503 when read-only; 404 for an unknown Pipeline; 400 without id; 422 for an invalid id or ERROR findings; 409 when the id or file exists; 202 when held for approval.

Body {name}: stamps the current identity as id, then sets the new display name, so the file, dirs, audit trail and Stream stay where they are. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 503 when read-only; 404 for an unknown Pipeline; 403 for a config outside the write root; 400 without name; 422 when the new name introduces ERROR findings; 202 when held for approval.

get.description: The Pipeline-level produces (default stream), reference and description, read off its config file. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown Pipeline.

post.summary: Save Pipeline produces and reference settings
post.description: Body {produces?, reference?, description?}; reference replaces the block wholesale and a blank description clears it. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 503 when read-only; 404 for an unknown Pipeline; 403 for a config outside the write root; 422 when the edit introduces ERROR findings; 202 when held for approval.

Body {newId, newName?, rewriteDependents?}: moves the id itself (config file, commit log, audit CSVs, acquisition ledger, status mirror and dependent configs), bracketed by rename.journal; dirs stay where they are. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 503 when read-only; 404 for an unknown Pipeline; 400 without newId; 422 for an invalid newId or relocateDirs; 409 when the Pipeline is active or running or the new id is taken.

Reads rename.journal for a begun but uncompleted rename and re-runs its remaining idempotent steps; optional body {oldId, newId} picks one when several are pending. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 503 when read-only; 404 when no incomplete rename is found; 409 when several match or the on-disk state conflicts.

get.summary: List a Pipeline's kept config versions, newest first
get.description: PIPELINE-CONFIG-HISTORY-1: every successful save of a Pipeline config snapshots it; the newest 50 are kept. Returns {pipeline, keep, total, versions:[{version, savedAt, bytes}]}. A read: no capability gate, like GET /pipelines/{pipelineId}/graph/raw. 404 for an unknown Pipeline.

get.summary: Line diff of two kept versions, or of one against the current config
get.description: Returns {pipeline, from, to, added, removed, coarse, lines:[{op: context|remove|add, text}]}. 400 when 'from' is missing or not a number, 404 for a version that is not kept.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: A version number, or 'current' (the default) for the config file as it is on disk now.

get.description: Returns {version, savedAt, bytes, pipeline, id, text}: text is the version's TOON, id the Pipeline id it declares (it differs from pipeline for a version saved before a rename, which restore refuses). 400 for a non-numeric version, 404 for one that is not kept.

post.description: Saves the version's exact bytes over the Pipeline's registered config file through the same content gate every save runs, records the result as a NEW version and refreshes the registry. Returns {pipeline, restored, version, path, findings}. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 503 writes disabled; 404 unknown/unregistered Pipeline or version not kept; 400 non-numeric version; 422 the version fails today's gate; 403 the registered file is outside the write root; 409 the version declares another Pipeline id (saved before a rename) or a stale If-Match.

get.summary: GET /tests - list the test cases of the bound Space
get.description: SE-6a. Reached as /spaces/{id}/tests. Lists the case folders under <space>/tests/ (each holding a case.toon): name, pipeline and input count, or the reason a case file is malformed. 503 when the Space has no config root. A read: no capability. Spec: docs/okf/product/module/config/spec-space-tests.md.

default.description: Envelope-wrapped response (see #/components/schemas/Envelope); data = {cases:[{name, pipeline, inputs, error?}]}.

get.summary: GET /integrity - the Space lock's report: broken links, duplicates, files changed outside the server
get.description: SE-1a. Reached as /spaces/{id}/integrity. Report-only: always 200 with status computing (the lock is computed in the background after boot and after server writes; ask again), ready {checkedAt, lockWrittenAt, baseline, baselineNote?, files, links, broken, duplicates, changedOutside - each list {total, items} with at most 200 items; columnChanges (SE-3a) {status, baseline, schemas, unknownSchemas, total, breaking, items, notAnalysed} - Schema column changes (added, type-widened, removed, renamed, type-narrowed) with the consumers each breaking one breaks, disabled under -Dcolumn.contract=off, spec docs/okf/product/module/config/spec-column-contract.md}, disabled (-Dspace.integrity=off) or unavailable (single-tenant default Space). A Space report also carries linksMode {configured: report|refuse-activation|unreadable, effective: report|refuse-activation, note?} - the safety-policy.toon links: mode (LC-4); columnsMode {configured: report|refuse-breaking|unreadable, effective: report|refuse-breaking, note?} - the safety-policy.toon columns: mode (SE-3b). Requires canAuthorWorkbench. Spec: docs/okf/product/module/config/spec-space-lock.md.

get.summary: GET /origin - which Space Template (and version) the Space came from, and what changed since
get.description: SE-5a. Reached as /spaces/{id}/origin. Report-only, always 200: status none (no origin recorded), unavailable (single-tenant default Space) or recorded {template, templateVersion, origin: created|adopted, recordedAt, space: {unchanged, changed, removed, added}, templateSince: {status: same-version|newer-version|missing, currentVersion, added?, changed?}} - config-relative paths. Requires canAuthorWorkbench. Spec: docs/okf/product/module/config/spec-space-origin.md.

post.summary: POST /integrity/accept - accept files changed outside the server so they leave the integrity report
post.description: LC-6 of SPACE-LINK-CENSUS-1. Reached as /spaces/{id}/integrity/accept. Body {paths?: [config-relative path, ...]}; absent = accept every file currently changedOutside (a git checkout, a template clone). Computes the lock afresh first, so the accepted hashes are the files' current ones; re-signs the lock; AUDIT event config.changed-outside.accepted under the caller's name. Requires canAdminister. Every edition. 503 lock off (-Dspace.integrity=off), no Space folder or no lock could be computed, 400 bad body, 404 a path that is not a config file of the Space, 200 {accepted:[{path, change, hash?}], notChangedOutside:[path], changedOutside (left), acceptedBy}. Spec: docs/okf/product/module/config/spec-space-lock.md.

post.summary: POST /origin/adopt - match an existing Space to a Space Template by file hash and record its origin
post.description: SE-5a. Reached as /spaces/{id}/origin/adopt. Body {template, version?}. Writes only <space>/.inspecto/created-from.toon and created-from.sha256, never config; records only when at least one config file matches. Requires canAdminister. 503 no Space folder, 400 bad body, 422 malformed version, 403 a template id that is not a bare id, 404 unknown template, 409 origin already recorded or version is not the template's current one, 200 {template, templateVersion, match: full|partial|none, recorded, matching, differing, onlyInTemplate, onlyInSpace}.

post.summary: POST /promotion/preview - the change set a whole-Space bundle would make in this existing Space
post.description: SE-6b. Reached as /spaces/{id}/promotion/preview. Body {bundle: base64 of a GET /export zip, parameters?: {NAME: value}}. Writes nothing. Each promotable config file is add | change | remove | same (decoded TOON less server stamps for .toon, bytes otherwise); what no import may write is listed under excluded. ${NAME} placeholders take the parameters; ${SPACE} is always this Space. Requires canAdminister. Kill switch -Dspace.promotion=off. 503 switched off or no config root, 400 bad body, 413 body over 64 MB, 422 not a whole-Space bundle or a placeholder with no value (missingParameters) or a value that makes a file unreadable (brokenByParameters), 200 {space, sourceSpace, changeSetHash, counts, changes, excluded, parametersUsed, approval: direct|pending-change}.

post.summary: POST /promotion/apply - apply a previewed change set to this existing Space
post.description: SE-6b, D-SE7. Reached as /spaces/{id}/promotion/apply. Body as the preview plus previewHash (the preview changeSetHash) and removals? (default false: files the bundle lacks are listed, not removed). Re-computes the change set. Under an approval policy the whole set is ONE Pending Change (202, kind space-promotion) applied on approval; otherwise written at once through the import journal (atomic, all or nothing). Requires canAdminister. 503 switched off or no config root, 400 bad body, 422 not a whole-Space bundle, a placeholder with no value, a value that makes a file unreadable or a promoted Pipeline escaping the allowed roots, 403 a carried kind the caller may not write, 409 changed since the preview or a promotion already pending, 202 held, 200 {space, applied, changeSetHash, written, removed, removalsSkipped}.

get.summary: GET /origin/upgrade - what a newer version of the Space's template would change, file by file
get.description: SE-5b. Reached as /spaces/{id}/origin/upgrade. Report-only, always 200. status none (no origin recorded), unavailable (single-tenant default Space), missing (the template is no longer installed), same-version, or proposal {template, fromVersion, toVersion, proposalId, files: [{path, kind?, change: update|add|conflict|kept|template-removed, recordedSha256, templateSha256, spaceSha256, refused?}], applicable: [paths an apply takes by default]}. Three-way: the recorded hash at creation, the installed template rendered for the Space, the Space's file now; .toon files compare as decoded TOON less the server's Job stamps. Requires canAuthorWorkbench. Spec: docs/okf/product/module/config/spec-space-origin.md.

post.summary: POST /origin/upgrade - apply the chosen update and add files of a template upgrade proposal
post.description: SE-5b. Reached as /spaces/{id}/origin/upgrade. Body {toVersion, files?: [config-relative paths, default every applicable update and add], proposalId?}. Never applies a conflict, kept or template-removed file and never deletes. Requires canAdminister. 503 no Space folder, 400 bad body, 422 malformed toVersion, 403 a named path that is not a plain relative path, 409 no origin recorded, 404 template no longer installed, 409 already at the template's version / toVersion not the installed version / proposalId not the current proposal (CONFLICT_STALE_VERSION), 403 a named file no import may write, 409 a named file that is not an update or add, 403 a file kind whose own route needs a capability the caller lacks, 202 one Pending Change for the whole set when the Space's approval policy holds any of its files (kind space-template-upgrade, name = template id; approving replays this request), 200 {template, fromVersion, toVersion, applied, recordedVersion, remaining, notApplied: [{path, change}]}. Files are written through the import journal (all or nothing) and the origin record is then rewritten: applied files' hashes = the bytes written, every other hash kept; templateVersion = toVersion only once no applicable update or add remains (an apply with nothing applicable left writes no file and records toVersion) (a partial apply keeps the old version, so the rest stays proposed).

post.summary: POST /tests/run - run the bound Space's test cases in scratch storage
post.description: SE-6a. Reached as /spaces/{id}/tests/run. Optional body {cases:[name,...]}; every case when absent. Each case runs through the run-to-here engine into a scratch root; nothing is written under the Space. Requires canAuthorWorkbench. 503 no config root, 400 bad body, 403 a case name that is not a plain name, 404 unknown case, 422 malformed case file, 200 {passed, total, failed, cases:[{name, pipeline, passed, error?, expectations:[{expectation, expected, actual, passed}]}]} - a failing case is a 200.

get.description: What the Pipeline points out to (schemas, mapping, grammar, shared components) and what points in at it (enrichments, Jobs, Datasets); ?limit= bounds the inward list, which reports the true total. No capability gate. 503 when there is no write root to scan; 422 for an unsafe name; 404 for an unknown Pipeline; 400 for a bad limit.

get.summary: Export a Pipeline with its file closure
get.description: Downloads a zip with manifest.toon, the Pipeline config, every referenced schema, grammar and mapping file under its bare name and companion enrichments; literal secrets are masked and a bound Connection becomes a requirement. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown Pipeline; 409 when two files collide on one bare name.

post.description: The body is the zip; ?name= retargets the id and ?conflict=refuse (default), overwrite or rename sets the conflict policy. The Pipeline always lands inactive, its files first. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 503 when read-only; 422 for an invalid bundle or ERROR findings; 403 for an entry that may not be written; 409 for a name conflict.

get.description: Every component of the kind the caller may view (empty when no write root is configured). A Dataset in this list also carries `empty` (LA-EMPTY-DATASET-WORDING-1): true when its store holds no data file yet (its Pipeline has not run, so a read answers 409), false when it holds one, null when that cannot be told cheaply (a view-backed Dataset, no data root, an unavailable ref). A directory check stopped at the first file, never a scan of rows; the one-component read does not carry it.

200.description: The components, each with identity, version metadata and content; a Dataset also with `empty`.

empty.description: Dataset components only: whether its store holds no data file yet; null when that cannot be told.

post.description: The path names the kind and the body is the component content with its id (or name). Gated on canAuthorWorkbench; a kind with its own route also needs that route's capability and a dedicated-only kind is refused 403. 503 when the control plane is read-only; 400 without id; 409 when it exists; 422 for invalid content; 202 when an approval policy holds it.

get.description: Prior saved copies of one component (kind, then id, in the path), newest first, each with version, savedAt, content hash and content; empty without a write root. No capability gate; the component's own view access applies. 404 for an unknown component; 400 for a bad kind.

post.description: Writes an archived version back as the current component; the restore is itself a versioned write. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench, plus the kind's own capability where it has a dedicated route. 503 when read-only; 400 for a non-integer version; 404 for an unknown component or version; 422 for invalid content.

post.summary: Test a transform component on sample rows
post.description: Runs body sampleRows through a stored transform.* component on a throwaway DuckDB; never touches production output. No capability gate; the component's view access applies. 404 for an unknown component; 422 when it is not a transform or the preview fails; 400 for a bad sample.

post.summary: Test a grammar component on sample text
post.description: Parses body sampleText with a stored grammar component's dialect on a throwaway DuckDB. No capability gate; the component's view access applies. 404 for an unknown component; 400 for bad input; 422 when the sample does not parse.

post.summary: Test a sink component on sample rows
post.description: Scratch-validates a stored sink component against body sampleRows (store, format and partition checks, a row count and a bounded sample); writes nothing. No capability gate; the component's view access applies. 404 for an unknown component; 400 for a bad sample.

Body {config, sampleRows}: the transform test over a config carried in the body instead of a stored component, on a throwaway DuckDB. No capability gate. 400 without config or for a bad sample; 422 when config is not transform.* or the preview fails.

Body {config, sampleText}: parses the sample with a grammar config carried in the body, on a throwaway DuckDB. No capability gate. 400 without config or for bad input; 422 when the sample does not parse.
Body {config, sampleRows}: scratch-validates a sink config carried in the body; writes nothing. No capability gate. 400 without config or for a bad sample.
Checks body rules and returns findings anchored to rules[N].<key> plus clean (no ERROR finding); writes nothing. No capability gate. 400 when rules is absent, not a list or holds a non-object.

post.summary: Derive a SQL transform's output columns
post.description: Runs DuckDB DESCRIBE over body sql against an empty input table built from inputColumns [{name, type}], reading no rows; the SQL passes the same guard as execution. No capability gate. 400 for a missing sql or inputColumns; 422 for a guard refusal or a binder or syntax error. With a config body instead (LOOKUP-1 P1d: {config: a keyed transform.join, inputColumns?, referenceColumns?: [{name, type}]}) it lists the columns that join adds as {columns: [{name, type, from, lookedUpBy, match, detail}]}, the Reference's columns read from the producing Pipeline's declared schema when referenceColumns is absent; 422 naming a clash, an unknown column, a non-keyed join or a Reference whose columns are unknown.

post.summary: Export components as a Metadata Bundle
post.description: Body {items:[{kind, id, refs?}], sourceSpace?, provenance?, requires?}: returns {bundle, missing, converted} with each found item's content and contentHash; a Connection carries no secret and a Live Working Set Widget leaves Frozen. No capability gate. 422 for an empty items list or an unsupported kind.

post.summary: Read-only fit-check of a Metadata Bundle against this Space
post.description: Body = a v2 bundle envelope. No writes, not capability-gated. Per item: new | unchanged | drifted | unsupported; per requires entry: satisfied | different | missing; integrity = the referential-integrity findings the items would INTRODUCE (the list /bundle/import refuses on) — advisory here, used by the editors' Import as draft before their own Save. Empty when writes are disabled.

Body {bundle, actions?} with per-item import, overwrite or skip: applies items in dependency order (by default a new item imports, an existing one is skipped) and reports each without aborting the rest. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench, plus each carried kind's own capability. 503 when read-only; 422 for an invalid envelope, an authored-pipeline item or broken references; 403 for access-config items; 409 under an approval policy.

get.description: The tables in this Space's Catalog. No capability gate.
Each Pipeline's Collector, with its Connection binding, as a STREAM catalog node; Pipelines that produce a Reference are listed under /catalog/references instead. No capability gate.
Every Reference (dimension) origin as a REFERENCE_DATASET catalog node. No capability gate.
Each KPI node with its definition, grain, join keys and resolved inputs, plus the merged domain notes. No capability gate.

A subgraph from ?from= to ?depth= (default 1) in ?direction= out, in or both (default both), filtered by ?kinds= and ?edgeKinds= (comma lists); ?overlay=true adds the operational overlay. No capability gate. 400 for an invalid direction, node kind or edge kind.

get.summary: Resolve a table or Pipeline to its Catalog node
get.description: ?table= resolves an output table name to its catalog node; ?pipeline= resolves a Pipeline to its event node, else its Stream node; table wins when both are given. Answers {id, label, kind}. No capability gate. 404 when no node, or more than one, resolves.

get.summary: One Catalog node with its neighbours
get.description: A catalog node of any kind with its operational overlay and its neighbours to depth 2. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown node.

post.summary: Suggest a draft schema from sample rows
post.description: Infers field types by TRY_CAST voting over body sampleRows on a scratch DuckDB and returns draft fields plus an identity mapping, never applied automatically; optional frontend picks index or name selectors, optional decimalSeparator ('.' or ',', the Grammar's decimal mark) reads number columns through it as the parse preview does, and a posted config adds a drift block. No capability gate. 400 without sampleRows, for an unknown frontend or another decimalSeparator; 422 when inference fails.

get.summary: Derived output schema of a saved Pipeline
get.description: For each schema the Pipeline in ?pipeline= declares, the output columns from DESCRIBE over the SELECT its transform would run, without executing it; reports which path (plugin or csv) was assumed. No capability gate. 400 without pipeline; 403 for a path instead of a bare name; 404 for an unknown Pipeline; 422 when it declares no schema or a schema does not compile.

post.summary: Deep-merge a patch into a config file
post.description: Body {type, name, patch, subdir?}: merges patch over the file's current content (maps merge, scalars and lists replace, null deletes), validates the whole result like /config/write and rewrites it atomically. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench (an alert also needs canAuthorAlertRules). 503 when read-only; 400 for a bad body; 404 for an unknown type or missing file; 403 for a subdir escape; 409 for an identity change; 422 for ERROR findings.

get.summary: What references a Pipeline, before a delete
get.description: The configs that still reference the Pipeline, so a caller sees what a delete would break; ?subdir= mirrors the delete route and ?limit= bounds the list (the true total is reported). Writes nothing. No capability gate. 503 when read-only; 422 for an unsafe name; 403 for a subdir escape; 400 for a bad limit or an absolute subdir; 404 for a missing config.

get.summary: What reads one mapped column of a Schema (column impact, report-only)
get.description: SPACE-LINK-CENSUS-1 LC-5. Every config that reads {columnId} as the Schema {schemaId} publishes it (its mapping.fields), from the link census: Dataset dateField and calculated expressions, Widget controls fields, Expectation column / refColumn / condition fields, Decision Rule condition fields, Reconciliation keyColumns / compareColumns / impact.column, and the column references of Enrichment transform, Query text and virtual Dataset sql read through the DuckDB parse tree. Matched case-insensitively, as DuckDB binds every consumer. Read-only: nothing is refused or rewritten. Answers {schema, path, column, mapped, total, consumers:[{kind, name, key, value}], notAnalysed:[{kind, name, key}]} - notAnalysed names the SQL texts the census could not read or attribute, which may read the column too. Optional ?subdir=. Gates in order: 503 no write root; 422 unsafe name; 403 escaping subdir or a reserved file; 404 no such Schema; 422 blank or over-long column.
Every parser plugin with its label, whether it is hierarchical and ingestable, its ingester class, its origin (builtin, classpath or a Job Pack) and its grammar schema. No capability gate.

The Decode Profile named by ?profile_file= (required), resolved beside ?subdir= (the Pipeline's directory), as {asn1}. No capability gate. 400 without profile_file or for an absolute subdir; 403 for a file outside the allowed roots; 422 for a file that is not a readable profile.

post.summary: Preview a sample with a parser
post.description: Parses body sample_text or sample_b64 with an in-progress grammar (optional subdir) and returns a table or a tree, plus derived rows for a hierarchical parser that declares them; scratch only. No capability gate, except that a Job Pack's parser needs canAuthorWorkbench. 404 for an unknown parser; 400 for a missing or oversized sample; 403 for a grammar file outside the allowed roots; 422 when the sample does not parse.

Body {target, measures?, group_by?, limit?}: writes the Dataset's data out as the target Dataset in an ad-hoc run and returns 202 with the runId and a Location to poll. Gated on canOperateRuns. 503 when read-only; 404 for an unknown Dataset; 422 for a missing, unsafe or self-referential target; 403 for a target escaping the data root; 409 when a materialize of the same target is running.

get.description: One page of the Dataset's relation (its view or physicalRef plus its calculated columns) — where GET /db/table reads the raw store. Same payload as /db/table: columns[{name,type,role,cardinality}], rows, statistics{rowCount,elapsedMs,truncated}. 503 write root unset · 404 unknown or shared-away Dataset · 422 unusable Dataset config or a failed read.

post.summary: Compare the storage growth of two or more hosted Spaces
post.description: Admits one ad-hoc space.comparison run over the maintenance_storage series of the named Spaces and returns 202 + runId + a Location to poll (GET /jobs/runs/{runId}). Gated on canAdminister: a cross-Space aggregate read. Nothing is persisted beyond the Run message and a space.comparison.completed signal in the requesting Space. 422 malformed body, 404 an unhosted Space, 409 a comparison already running here.

axes.description: Only these storage axes; every axis when omitted

202.description: Accepted; the comparison is running. Poll the Location.

post.summary: Run a headless BI Measure query

window.description: A trailing window as of a date: only rows whose field, read as a DATE, is in (asOf - days, asOf] feed every measure and ratio (days absent = no lower bound). asOf is always stated. Gives the recency aggregate its as-of; recency is refused without a window.

ratios.description: num / den of two aggregates as a DOUBLE, NULL when den is 0. The column id is <numId>_per_<denId>.

orderBy.description: ORDER BY terms. A term over a result column (a grouped Dimension or a Measure id) orders by it. A term carrying agg, or naming a Dataset column that is not in the result, orders by that column wrapped in a hidden aggregate (default min) while grouping stays unchanged. The column must be a real, unclassified Dataset column and the spec needs a measure and a groupBy, else 422.

cosmetic.description: Set by a chart for its category order only: honoured on a groupBy Dimension with no agg. For a caller who may not see raw entity keys the server drops a cosmetic term over a masked column and orders by the first Measure descending instead; any other order over a masked column is still refused (422).

post.description: Body {dataset, measures[{agg, field}], groupBy[], filters[], orderBy[], limit}: compiled to guarded SQL and run in the query sandbox over the Dataset, returning the Result Set and the compiled SQL; classified keys are masked unless the caller may reveal them. No capability gate. 503 when read-only; 404 for an unknown or hidden Dataset; 422 for a bad spec, an unsafe identifier or a SQL guard failure.

get.description: The curated Widget and Dashboard template gallery, metadata only. No capability gate.

post.description: Body {dataset, prefix?, columns?}: writes the template's Widget and Dashboard components for the Dataset, columns mapping the template's columns to the Dataset's. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 404 for an unknown template or Dataset; 422 for a missing dataset or a bad column mapping; 409 when a target component exists (re-apply with a prefix); 503 when read-only.

get.description: The business-data tables (Parquet or CSV folders under the Space's data directory) with their owning Dataset, plus the operational table groups when a store runs on a DB backend. No capability gate. 503 when read-only or the data directory cannot be listed.

?group= (default stores), ?name= (required), ?limit= (default 200, max 5000), ?offset= and ?sort=field:dir, read in a DuckDB sandbox. No capability gate for business data; an ops:* group needs canAuthorWorkbench, and canRevealLinkEntities when it holds classified keys. 503 when read-only; 400 without name; 404 for an unknown group or table; 403 for a path escaping the data root.

post.summary: Run read-only SQL against one table
post.description: Body {group?, table, sql, limit?, offset?}: the SQL must pass the read-only SQL guard and runs in a DuckDB sandbox. No capability gate for business data; an ops:* group needs canAuthorWorkbench and canRevealLinkEntities. 503 when read-only; 422 for a missing sql or table, a guard refusal or a failed query; 404 for an unknown group or table; 403 for a path escaping the data root.

post.summary: Create a public share link for a Dashboard
post.description: Mints an HMAC-signed token valid for body ttl_hours (default 168, at most one year) and returns token, url and expiresAt. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 503 when sharing is disabled (no -Dbi.share.secret) or the control plane is read-only; 404 for an unknown Dashboard.

get.description: Anonymous: the path segment is the share token, which is the credential. Returns the shared Dashboard and the Widgets it references, read-only. No capability gate. 404 for an invalid, expired or tampered token or a deleted Dashboard; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Query the data behind a shared Dashboard
post.description: Anonymous BI query (body as /bi/query, path segment = share token) fenced to the Datasets the Dashboard's Widgets reference; the Dashboard's stored filter and default date range replace the body's filters, and classified keys are always masked. No capability gate. 404 for a bad token or unknown Dataset; 403 for a Dataset the link does not cover; 422 for a bad spec or a guard failure.

get.description: Lists every Expectation in the registry, sorted by name, each with its persisted lastResult. No capability gate. Returns an empty list when the write root is unset.

post.description: Creates an Expectation from the body; unknown top-level keys are refused. May be held for approval (202) under an approval policy. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 409 when the name already exists; 422 for an invalid body or a dangling link; 503 when the write root is unset.
Evaluates all Expectations against their targets' at-rest data, persists each lastResult and opens an Incident for a failure. Gated on canOperateRuns. 503 when the write root is unset.
Evaluates the named Expectation, persists its lastResult and opens an Incident on failure. Gated on canOperateRuns. 404 for an unknown Expectation; 503 when the write root is unset.

put.description: Replaces the named Expectation from the body, keeping its lastResult and createdAt. May be held for approval (202) under an approval policy. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 404 for an unknown Expectation; 422 for an invalid body; 503 when the write root is unset.

delete.description: Deletes the named Expectation and its baseline profile history. May be held for approval (202) under an approval policy. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 404 for an unknown Expectation; 503 when the write root is unset.

get.description: Lists every Requirement, oldest submission first, with its id, kind and lifecycle status. No capability gate. Returns an empty list when the write root is unset.

post.description: Submits a Requirement (body id or name, title, kind kpi|report|reconciliation|rule, description; a kpi one may carry target, comparator and unit) in status submitted. No capability gate. 422 for a missing id or title or an unknown kind; 409 when the id already exists; 503 when the write root is unset.

Decides a submitted Requirement: body accept (true accepts, otherwise rejects) and an optional note. Gated on canTriageRequirements. 404 for an unknown Requirement; 409 when it is not in status submitted; 503 when the write root is unset.

Moves an accepted Requirement to status delivered, with an optional body note. Gated on canTriageRequirements. 404 for an unknown Requirement; 409 when it is not in status accepted; 503 when the write root is unset.

get.description: Lists the registered Jobs; an enabled Job held by the activation check carries a held reason. Optional limit/offset, cursor-paginated on /api/v1. No capability gate. Returns an empty list when no Jobs are registered.

post.description: Creates a scheduled Job from the body (name, type, cron and parameters), validated by the Job spec and config-safety gate, persisted and hot-registered. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canAuthorWorkbench; an event_prune, restore or audit_anchor_export maintenance Job also needs canAdminister. 409 when the name exists; 422 for an invalid body or an unregistered type; 503 when the write root is unset.

put.description: Replaces a Job's config and hot-registers it; honours If-Match. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canAuthorWorkbench; event_prune, restore and audit_anchor_export maintenance Jobs also need canAdminister. 404 for an unknown Job; 400 when the body name differs from the path; 409 for a stale If-Match or a platform system Job; 422 for an invalid body; 503 when the write root is unset.

delete.description: Removes a Job's config file and unregisters it. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 404 for an unknown Job; 409 for a platform system Job; 503 when the write root is unset.

get.description: Returns one Job's full config with secret-declared parameters masked, plus an ETag for a later conditional PUT. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown Job or when no Jobs are registered.

Lists every registered Job Type's descriptor (params, emits, artifacts) with its provenance: implClass, source (builtin, classpath or pack) and version. No capability gate. 404 when no Jobs are registered.
Returns one Job Type's descriptor with its provenance (implClass, source, version). No capability gate. 404 for an unknown Job Type or when no Jobs are registered.
Returns the registered $-token expression catalog for Job parameters; context-free tokens carry a preview value. No capability gate. 404 when no Jobs are registered.

Returns the ConsignmentProcessor ids a consignment.process Job may select, capped and flagged truncated when over the cap; empty on a stock install. No capability gate. 404 when no Jobs are registered.
Returns the inventory of loaded Job Packs. No capability gate. 404 when no Jobs are registered.

post.description: Reconciles the Job Pack directory now (load, reload, unload) and returns the transition summary. Gated on canOperateRuns. 404 when no Jobs are registered.

get.description: Returns aggregate Run counts (total, success and more) from the Job Run reporting store, optionally for one Job (query job). No capability gate. 404 when no Jobs are registered or the reporting store is not enabled.
Returns one page of Job Runs, newest first (query limit up to 500, job, cursor; cursor-paginated). No capability gate. 404 when no Jobs are registered or the reporting store is not enabled.
Returns per-day totals and failed Run counts for the most recent days (query days, default 30). No capability gate. 404 when no Jobs are registered or the reporting store is not enabled.

post.description: Re-fires the Job behind a finished Run with the Job's configured defaults (parameters are not persisted); returns the new runId and replayOf, 202 with a Location on /api/v1. Gated on canOperateRuns. 404 for an unknown Run or a Job whose module is disabled; 409 while the Job is running or when it is no longer registered.

get.description: Returns the Run history of one Job from the Run ledger. No capability gate. 404 when no Jobs are registered.
Returns the structured Run Log entries of one Run; only the Run id is used to look it up. No capability gate. 404 when no Jobs are registered.

get.summary: One Run's log for live tail
get.description: Returns one Run's Run Log reshaped for the live-tail panel as {logs:[{ts,level,message}], events:[]}; only the Run id is used. No capability gate. 404 when no Jobs are registered.

post.description: Sets a Job's persisted enabled flag to true and hot-registers it. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canOperateRuns. 404 for an unknown Job; 409 for a platform system Job; 422 when the Job's type is not registered; 503 when the write root is unset.

Sets a Job's persisted enabled flag to false and hot-registers it. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canOperateRuns. 404 for an unknown Job; 409 for a platform system Job; 503 when the write root is unset.

Replaces a Job's persisted cron with body cron. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 422 when cron is missing or the result is invalid; 404 for an unknown Job; 409 for a platform system Job; 503 when the write root is unset.

get.description: Returns the Run Artifacts one Run recorded, in write order; only the Run id is used. No capability gate. 404 when no Jobs are registered.

get.summary: Latest Run Artifacts of a Job
get.description: Returns the output Run Artifacts of the Job's most recent successful Run (the parameter receipt excluded); empty when there is none. No capability gate. 404 when no Jobs are registered.

Streams the bytes of a file-kind Run Artifact recorded by the Run, with a Content-Type inferred from its extension, as an attachment. No capability gate. 404 when the Run recorded no such artifact, it is not a file, or the file is gone from disk.

get.summary: Record counts of one Pipeline Run
get.description: Returns per-(node, relationship) record counts of one Pipeline Run for painting onto the Pipeline graph edges (query pipeline, or its pre-rename alias, and consignment, or batch, its pre-4.0.0 alias, deprecated until 5.0.0). No capability gate. 400 when pipeline or consignment is missing; 404 when the provenance store is not enabled or no Jobs are registered.

get.summary: List recent batches of a Pipeline
get.description: Returns a Pipeline's recent Runs, newest first, each as consignmentId, runTs, totalRows and simulated (plus batchId, the pre-4.0.0 name of consignmentId, deprecated until 5.0.0), to pick one for provenance (query pipeline, or its pre-rename alias, and limit, default 20). No capability gate. 400 when pipeline is missing; 404 when the provenance store is not enabled or no Jobs are registered.

The Signal ledger filtered by ?type= (exact or prefix.* glob), ?since= and ?until= (epoch millis), ?severity= (minimum), ?source= (emitter kind or kind:id) and ?correlationId=; ?limit= defaults to 200, max 5000. No capability gate. 400 for a non-numeric time bound or an unknown severity.

get.summary: Causation tree of one correlation chain
get.description: The Signals of ?correlationId= (required) assembled into a parent-to-child forest, each node with the Signals it caused as children, oldest first; ?limit= as for /signals. No capability gate. 400 without correlationId.

Server-Sent Events of new Signals matching ?type=, ?severity=, ?source= and ?correlationId= as set at open time, with a heartbeat every 15 s; no history replay. No capability gate. 400 for an unknown severity.

For ?store= (an output table name, required): upstream, the ingest rows (Pipeline, Consignment id, input file, partition, row count) that landed in it, and downstream, the authored Pipelines that read it with their sinks; each half is empty when its inputs are absent. No capability gate. 400 without store.
A view of every registered Stage-2 enrichment Job. No capability gate. 404 when no enrichment Jobs are registered.

post.summary: Register an enrichment Job from a config on disk
post.description: Body {configPath}, absolute or relative to the write root: validates spec and safety and hot-registers the enrichment, replacing one of the same name. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 503 when read-only; 400 without configPath; 403 for a path outside the write root; 404 when no file is there; 422 for ERROR findings or an invalid config.

post.summary: Preview an enrichment draft on sample rows
post.description: Body {config, sampleRows}: runs the draft's transform over the sample plus the real reference views and returns up to 200 rows; nothing persists. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 400 without config or sampleRows; 403 for a reference path outside the allowed roots; 422 when the draft is invalid or fails on the sample.

get.summary: Run audit of an enrichment Job
get.description: The recorded Runs of the enrichment Job named in the path. No capability gate. 404 when the enrichment Job is not registered.

get.summary: Output lineage of an enrichment Job
get.description: The output lineage of the enrichment Job named in the path, optionally for one ?runId=. No capability gate. 404 when the enrichment Job is not registered.

get.summary: Run-audit report of an enrichment Job
get.description: The rollup over the enrichment Job's Runs, optionally scoped by ?from=&to=. No capability gate. 404 when the enrichment Job is not registered.

Lists the most recent fired Alerts (query limit, default 50); a key named in a message is masked for a caller who may not reveal it. No capability gate. Returns an empty list when the alert engine is not running.
Lists the Alert Rules armed in the running alert engine. No capability gate. Returns an empty list when the alert engine is not running.

post.description: Creates an Alert Rule (owned by the caller) and arms it in the running engine. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canAuthorAlertRules. 409 when the name exists; 422 on a Basic build, an invalid or unknown key, a by or window column not in the Dataset's Schema, an Investigation rule or an unknown runbook; 403 when naming another owner; 503 when the write root is unset.

get.description: Lists the deferred Alert Rules still waiting on their Risk Score's first run, each with its lastRefusal once refused. No capability gate. Returns an empty list when the write root is unset.

post.description: Runs a manual evaluation sweep over every armed Alert Rule; a fired rule emits ALERT_FIRED, which notification rules may dispatch. Gated on canOperateRuns. 503 when the alert engine is not armed.

put.description: Replaces an Alert Rule (the name comes from the path, owner and shares carried forward) and re-arms it. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canAuthorAlertRules. 404 for an unknown Alert Rule; 403 without edit access or when a non-owner changes owner or shares; 422 on a Basic build or an invalid body; 503 when the write root is unset.

delete.description: Deletes an Alert Rule and disarms it in the running engine. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canAuthorAlertRules. 404 for an unknown Alert Rule; 503 when the write root is unset or the alert engine is unavailable.

get.description: Lists every Decision Rule, ordered by priority then name. No capability gate. Returns an empty list when the write root is unset.

post.description: Creates a Decision Rule from the body (name, when condition tree, consequences). May be held for approval (202). Gated on canAuthorWorkbench; an invoke-api consequence also needs canWorkIncidents. 409 when the name exists; 422 without a name or consequence, for an invalid when tree or an invalid invoke-api consequence; 503 when the write root is unset.

get.description: Lists every consequence action an author may name as {id, displayName, group, available, reason?, module?, requires?}; an action whose module or required service is missing is listed unavailable with the reason. No capability gate. Hand-kept note: the data array lists every Decision Rule consequence an author may name, [{id, displayName, group (routing|platform|notify|object|integration), available, reason?, module?, requires?}]; available=false means the providing module/service is not installed in this bundle.

put.description: Replaces a Decision Rule (name from the path), keeping its lastSimulation and createdAt. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canAuthorWorkbench; an invoke-api consequence also needs canWorkIncidents. 404 for an unknown Decision Rule; 422 for an invalid body; 503 when the write root is unset.
