delete.description: Deletes a Decision Rule. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 404 for an unknown Decision Rule; 503 when the write root is unset.

post.description: Evaluates the rule's when tree over body sampleRows, stores lastSimulation {matched, total, checkedAt} and returns the rule; no sample gives 0/0. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 404 for an unknown Decision Rule; 422 for an invalid stored when tree; 503 when the write root is unset.

Runs each consequence of the rule once, attributed to the caller, with an optional body record for emit-signal payload mappings; returns what each did. Gated on canOperateRuns; an emit-signal offered to another Space also needs canOfferSignals. 404 for an unknown Decision Rule; 400 when record is not an object; 422 for a target-Space parameter, an unmapped payload field or no active signal grant; 503 when the write root is unset.

Runs a stored Rule Template with body params bound to its declared :name holes as real binds over its Dataset, returning the matched rows and what each hole was bound to; body limit defaults to 500, max 10000. Persists nothing. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 503 when read-only; 404 for an unknown template or Dataset; 422 for an undeclared hole, a bad parameter, a guard refusal or a failed query.

get.description: A flat view of every Pipeline's Collector acquisition config. No capability gate.

post.summary: Tell a Collector a file has landed
post.description: Fires the Pipeline that owns the Collector now instead of waiting for its poll; the body is ignored. On /api/v1 it answers 202 with the runId and a Location to poll. Gated on canOperateRuns. 404 for an unknown Collector.

get.description: The acquisition counters, gauges and histogram (files discovered and downloaded, failures, bytes, fetch time, stream lag and more) as JSON; also served at the bare unversioned path. No capability gate.

Returns the caller's active notification feed, newest first (query limit, default 50), with read state per reader; addressed, security and in-app-disabled notifications are filtered per caller. No capability gate.
Holds a Server-Sent Events stream open and pushes each new notification the caller may see as a data frame, with a heartbeat comment every 15 seconds. No capability gate.
Returns {count}: active notifications visible to the caller that the caller has not read. No capability gate.

post.description: Marks every active notification read for the caller and returns {updated}, the number that changed. No capability gate (self-service, per reader).
Marks one notification read for the caller and returns it as the caller sees it. No capability gate (self-service, per reader). 404 for an unknown notification or one the caller may not see.
Marks one notification unread for the caller and returns it as the caller sees it. No capability gate (self-service, per reader). 404 for an unknown notification or one the caller may not see.

get.summary: The caller’s effective notification preference grid
get.description: Each cell is the calling Subject’s override when it has one, else the deployment default; source marks which (inherited | overridden). Critical categories are always on. email is off and not editable for a Subject with no verified email claim; webhook is never personal. Basic (no Subject): the single grid.

default.description: Envelope-wrapped response (see #/components/schemas/Envelope): data is the grid, one row per category — {category, label, critical, available, channels:{inApp, email, webhook}, source:{channel: inherited | overridden}, editable:{channel: boolean}}.

put.summary: Save the caller’s own preference override (self-service)
put.description: Body {"preferences":[{category, channels:{inApp?, email?}}]}. Writes ONLY the calling Subject’s override, keyed by its stable id; a null cell resets it to the default. Critical categories, webhook, and email-on without a verified email claim are ignored, as is any address in the body — email goes to the Subject’s verified claim only. Basic (no Subject): writes the single grid. 503 when the deployment overrides file exists but is unreadable. Returns the caller’s effective grid.

default.description: Envelope-wrapped response (see #/components/schemas/Envelope): data is the grid, one row per category — {category, label, critical, available, channels:{inApp, email, webhook}, source:{channel: inherited | overridden}, editable:{channel: boolean}}.

get.description: The grid every Subject inherits where it has no override (source is always inherited).

default.description: Envelope-wrapped response (see #/components/schemas/Envelope): data is the grid, one row per category — {category, label, critical, available, channels:{inApp, email, webhook}, source:{channel: inherited | overridden}, editable:{channel: boolean}}.

put.description: Body {"preferences":[{category, channels:{inApp?, email?, webhook?}}]}. Requires canAdminister (403 PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise). Changes the effective grid of every Subject that has not overridden that cell. Critical categories stay locked on. Returns the refreshed default grid.

default.description: Envelope-wrapped response (see #/components/schemas/Envelope): data is the grid, one row per category — {category, label, critical, available, channels:{inApp, email, webhook}, source:{channel: inherited | overridden}, editable:{channel: boolean}}.

get.description: Lists the saved notification channel destinations. No capability gate. Returns an empty list when the write root is unset.

post.description: Creates a notification channel destination from the body; keys the channel does not model are refused. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 409 when the id exists; 422 for missing fields or an invalid body; 503 when the write root is unset.

put.description: Merges the body over a saved notification channel; the id and createdAt stay as stored. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 404 for an unknown channel; 422 for an invalid body; 503 when the write root is unset.

delete.description: Deletes a saved notification channel destination. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 404 for an unknown channel; 503 when the write root is unset.

get.description: Lists the operator-authored notification rules. No capability gate. Returns an empty list when the write root is unset.

post.description: Creates an authored notification rule from the body; keys the rule does not model are refused. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 409 when the id exists; 422 for missing fields or an invalid body; 503 when the write root is unset.

put.description: Replaces an authored notification rule; the id comes from the path. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 404 for an unknown notification rule; 422 for an invalid body; 503 when the write root is unset.

delete.description: Deletes an authored notification rule. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 404 for an unknown notification rule; 503 when the write root is unset.
Archives one notification for the whole Space, removing it from every user's feed; returns {id, deleted}. Gated on canAdminister. 404 for an unknown notification.

post.description: Inbound email-provider callback for the named delivery-status adapter (served under /api/v1): verifies the signature over the raw body, then stamps the matching delivery receipts. No capability gate; the signature is the check. 404 for an unknown or unconfigured adapter; 413 over 512 KiB; 403 for a bad signature; 422 when the payload has no events; 202 when every delivery id is unknown.

200.description: Verified. Either the stamped events, or {"control": kind} for a verified message that carries no delivery events (an SNS SubscriptionConfirmation / UnsubscribeConfirmation), with duplicate:true for a replayed MessageId; no receipt is written for a control message.

413.description: Body over the 512 KiB callback cap (errorCode PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE); never reaches signature verification.

429.description: Per-caller-IP callback budget exhausted (errorCode RATE_LIMITED); providers retry.

get.description: Returns {deliveries}: recent delivery receipts (query limit, default 100) or all for one notification (query notificationId), each with every observed status and its time. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench.

Returns the currently suppressed destinations with their reasons (query limit, default 100, at most 500), the true total, a truncated flag, and whether suppression is armed. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench.

delete.description: Records an override that forgives a destination's delivery history (query target), so it is delivered to again; receipts are kept and a later bounce suppresses it again. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 422 when target is blank; 409 when delivery receipts are not stored durably.

get.description: Returns the Space's branding {logoDataUrl, caption, footerText}; nulls mean the shipped defaults. Carries an ETag and answers 304 for a fresh If-None-Match. No capability gate.

put.description: Replaces the Space's branding with body logoDataUrl, caption and footerText. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 422 when logoDataUrl exceeds 512K characters; 503 when the write root is unset.

get.description: Returns the Space's {tileServerUrl}; null means no self-hosted tile server. Carries an ETag and answers 304 for a fresh If-None-Match. No capability gate.

put.description: Replaces the Space's geo settings with body tileServerUrl. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 503 when the write root is unset.

get.description: Returns the Space's processor icon map as {<type>: {glyph, color}}; an empty object when none is set. Carries an ETag and answers 304 for a fresh If-None-Match. No capability gate.

put.summary: Replace the Space's processor icon map
put.description: Replaces the Space's processor icon map with the body, an object of {glyph, color} entries keyed by processor type. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 422 when an entry is not an object or lacks a glyph or color; 503 when the write root is unset.

get.description: Returns the Space's Menu tree {space, version, landing?, nodes}; an empty tree before any save. Carries an ETag and answers 304 for a fresh If-None-Match. No capability gate.

put.description: Replaces the whole Menu tree with body version, nodes and optional landing. Gated on canCurateMenus. 422 for a wrong version or invalid nodes or landing; 503 when the write root is unset.

get.description: Returns the effective role table, authored roles over the shipped seed, each row with capabilities, data scopes and source, plus identity settings and capabilities per product; an unreadable roles document is reported, not hidden. Carries an ETag. No capability gate.

put.description: Fully replaces the authored roles document (body roles, optional identity.attributeClaims and identity.machineClients); seed roles not named keep their defaults. Honours If-Match and may be held for approval (202). Gated on canConfigureAccess. 409 for a stale If-Match; 422 for an invalid roles list or a change that would leave the access policies unloadable; 503 when the write root is unset.

get.description: Returns each capability the role grants, allowed or denied by its Access Profile with the reason, its data scopes and whether an access policy engine is active. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown role.

Returns authored access policies plus the engine's seed policies in force, lint warnings and the resource kinds vocabulary; an unreadable document is reported, its detail only to a caller holding canConfigureAccess. Carries an ETag. No capability gate.

put.description: Fully replaces the authored access policies document (body policies). Honours If-Match and may be held for approval (202). Gated on canConfigureAccess. 409 for a stale If-Match; 422 for an invalid policy or a draft that would deny the caller's own next save; 503 when the write root is unset.

post.summary: Impact matrix for an unsaved Access Policy draft
post.description: Gated canConfigureAccess. Body {policies, route?} is validated exactly like PUT /access/policies (422 on the same checks). Returns {enabled, route, roles, actions, kinds, cells: [{role, action, resourceKind, before, beforePolicy, after, afterPolicy, changed}], warnings: [{policy, code, message}]} — every effective role as a synthetic subject (capabilities + role name, no id or claims) x read/write/operate, plus x each known resource kind a current or draft policy targets. Writes nothing. {enabled:false} without a policy engine (Basic and Standard). A POST, so the route PEP evaluates it as a write against the saved doc.

get.summary: Explain an access decision for my session
get.description: Dry-runs the access policy engine for the caller (query route, method default GET, optional resourceKind) and returns the decision, matched policy and per-policy trace; {enabled:false} without a policy engine or an authenticated subject. No capability gate. 422 when route is missing.
Returns the saved Access Catalog (the tree of menu, pane and action nodes), or an empty version-0 catalog when none is saved. Carries an ETag. No capability gate.

put.description: Replaces the Access Catalog with body version and nodes; each node needs a unique safe id, a label, a kind of menu|pane|action and, for an action, a known capability. Honours If-Match and may be held for approval (202). Gated on canConfigureAccess. 409 for a stale If-Match; 422 for an invalid node tree; 503 when the write root is unset.

get.description: Lists every saved Access Profile, sorted by name. No capability gate. Returns an empty list when the write root is unset.

put.description: Creates or replaces the Access Profile whose id is <subjectType>-<subjectId> (body subjectType lens|role, subjectId, label, grants of nodeId to allow|deny). Honours If-Match and may be held for approval (202). Gated on canConfigureAccess. 409 for a stale If-Match; 422 for an unsafe or mismatched id, a bad subjectType or invalid grants; 503 when the write root is unset.

delete.description: Deletes an Access Profile. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canConfigureAccess. 404 for an unknown Access Profile; 422 for an unsafe id; 503 when the write root is unset.

get.description: Searches AUDIT or ACCESS_DENIED events (query type required; limit, offset, pipeline, correlationId, q, from, to); classified values are masked for a caller who may not unmask them. No capability gate. 400 when type is missing or not one of the auditable types.

Exports AUDIT or ACCESS_DENIED events with the same filters as search; format=csv returns the audit-shaped CSV with one column per audit attribute, otherwise JSON. Classified values are masked as on search. No capability gate. 400 when type is missing or not auditable.
Returns the assist agent's recent failure diagnoses (query limit, default 50). No capability gate. Returns an empty list when the optional agent module is absent.
Returns the server-wide assist model-provider settings as the agent reports them. No capability gate. 503 when the optional agent module is absent.

post.description: Saves the server-wide assist model-provider settings (including provider and baseUrl) from the body. Gated on canAdminister. 400 for an invalid setting; 503 when the optional agent module is absent.

get.description: Returns the assist agent's usage metrics. No capability gate. 503 when the optional agent module is absent.

post.description: Makes a round-trip call to the saved model provider and returns the result. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 503 when the optional agent module is absent.

Dispatches one request to the assist skill named by the path intent, with body screenContext, partialInput and userText, and returns its result. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown intent; 503 when the agent module is absent or the skill's model is unavailable.

get.description: The per-kind maker-checker policy persisted as `approval.toon` in the Space's config tree, plus the read-only facts a policy editor needs: `governable` (the kinds a policy may name), `defaultApproverCapability` and `failedClosed`. Open to any caller (reads are not capability-gated). Default OFF: no file (or no write root) reads as an empty `approval` map with `expiresAfterHours` 168. A file that is present but unreadable or invalid is NOT read as off — it holds every governable kind with the defaults and reports `failedClosed: true`; `approval` is then empty and the held kinds are exactly those in `governable`.

put.description: Replaces `approval.toon` wholesale and returns the policy as GET reads it. Requires canAdminister (not canAuthorWorkbench: turning maker-checker off is the one change an author must not be able to make), and is itself never held for approval. Validated fail-closed: an unknown key, a kind outside `governable`, an `approverCapability` no route demands, `expiresAfterHours` outside 1..8784, a non-boolean flag, or a policy requiring approval on a build with no Authenticator is refused. Lenient scalars: `expiresAfterHours` also accepts its string form (`"168"`), the boolean flags accept `"true"`/`"false"`, and a missing or blank `approverCapability` falls back to `canApproveChanges`. An empty or absent body is refused (422): turning four-eyes off must be explicit, `{"approval": {}}`. With no Authenticator configured the route is refused outright (403), so the policy can never be switched off unauthenticated — a Basic install cannot change it through the API (operator, 2026-09-28). Emits one `approval-policy.changed` audit event carrying the policy before and after.

post.summary: Approve a Pending Change and apply it
post.description: Requires canApproveChanges (the route) and then the kind's `approverCapability` (in the handler). Gates in order: canApproveChanges 403 → no authenticated Subject 403 → write root 503 → `reason` over 500 chars 422 → unsafe id 422 → unknown 404 → MAC does not verify 409 → not pending (decided, withdrawn or expired) 409 → the kind's approverCapability 403 → with `fourEyes`, the author approving their own change 403. The original request is then replayed through the route it was proposed through, AS ITS AUTHOR with their authority re-checked now; only a replay that writes exactly the approved content applies. Decided under a cross-process compare-and-set: of two concurrent decisions one wins, the other is 409.

parameters.name: pendingchangeId
parameters.description: The Pending Change id, `pc-<yyyyMMddHHmmss>-<6 hex>`; any other shape is 422.

200.description: Applied: `applied: true`, the change `approved`, and `result` carrying the replayed route's own status and body.

403.description: canApproveChanges or the kind's approverCapability missing; no authenticated Subject (an author and a decider cannot be told apart — Basic, which has no Authenticator, is always refused here); the author deciding their own four-eyes change; or the author no longer holds what the change needs (PERMISSION_DENIED).

409.description: Already decided, withdrawn or expired; integrity check failed; the recorded request is not a maker-checker route; or the target changed since the change was proposed — the change is then closed `stale` (CONFLICT).

422.description: Unsafe id or `reason` over 500 chars (CONFIG_VALIDATION_FAILED); a replay refused by its route with 422 comes back as that 422 and leaves the change pending.

503.description: Write root unset (CONTROL_PLANE_READ_ONLY), or the store locked beyond the wait bound (STORE_BUSY).

post.description: Closes the change `declined`, unapplied; the target is free for a new proposal. Gates as approve up to and including four-eyes (an author may not decline their own four-eyes change — they withdraw it). Audited as `pending-change.declined`.

post.description: The AUTHOR takes back a change they proposed: it closes `withdrawn`, unapplied, signed and audited (`pending-change.withdrawn`) as a decline is. Same cross-process compare-and-set as approve: a withdraw racing an approve leaves exactly one outcome.

get.description: Returns {hosts}: the exact hosts a publish.postgres Job may write Datasets to; empty by default. No capability gate.

put.description: Replaces the publication destination allowlist with body hosts and audits before and after. Gated on canAdminister. 422 for an unknown key, a non-list, too many hosts or an invalid host; 503 when the write root is unset.

get.summary: Evaluate a KPI definition for the period to date
get.description: Evaluates the `kpi` registry component's Measure over the current `grain` period to date and over the SAME elapsed length of the comparison period (KpiEvaluator), in ONE explicit zone: the KPI's `timezone`, else UTC. A read, so ungated. 503 write root unset · 400 unsafe id or bad `asOf` · 404 unknown or shared-away KPI, and a Dataset that is absent OR unreadable by the caller (the same answer on purpose) · 422 a stored KPI that no longer validates, or a failed relation / DuckDB read.

parameters.name: asOf
parameters.description: The day the period runs to (inclusive): YYYY-MM-DD, or an ISO instant read as its date in the KPI's zone. Absent: today in that zone. A future day, one before year 1, or an unplaceable instant is a 400. Ignored when from and to are sent.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day (inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD) of a range to read the KPI over instead of the grain's period to date. Send with to. The comparison is the equal-length period before the range (or the same dates a year earlier, or none, as the KPI declares).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day (inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD) of the range; the answer's asOf is this day. Send with from. 400 when only one of from and to is sent, when from is after to, for a future day, a malformed day, or a span over 3660 days.

200.description: The KPI's value, comparison and RAG band.

post.summary: Create a KPI definition from a delivered kpi Requirement
post.description: An explicit authoring action — delivering a Requirement never creates a KPI by itself. Requires canAuthorWorkbench (403 PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise). The Requirement supplies what Business authored on it: `title`, `target`, `unit`, and the good `direction` read off its `comparator` (>= / > → up, <= / < → down); the body supplies what only a Builder knows. Body keys win. The KPI is saved through the same gate as /components/kpi (KpiRoutes.requireMeasure: the Dataset exists and is readable by the author, the measure field and `timeField` are in its Schema, `timeField` is DATE/TIMESTAMP/TIMESTAMPTZ), then the maker-checker hold, then the write, and the Requirement is stamped `kpi: <id>`. 503 write root unset · 404 unknown Requirement · 422 unsafe id, not a kpi Requirement, an invalid KPI or a Measure that does not exist for this author · 409 not delivered, already created one, or a KPI of that id exists.

200.description: The KPI written — its stored content, with `name` = the KPI id and `requirement` = the Requirement id.

202.description: Held by the Space's Approval Policy for `kpi` — nothing was written, and the Requirement is not stamped until the Pending Change is approved (the approval replays this request).

pendingChange.description: The Pending Change record without its content (id, kind, name, operation, status, author, createdAt, expiresAt, approverCapability, fourEyes, …) — GET /pending-changes/{id} reads it in full.

403.description: The caller lacks canAuthorWorkbench (PERMISSION_DENIED) — Standard and Advanced only.

get.description: Recomputes the Space's audit hash chain over an optional seq range (query from, to; epoch=current) and returns ok or the first bad seq with its reason; a broken chain is still a 200. Gated on canAdminister. 400 when from or to is not a positive integer or from is after to.

Returns the Space's signed audit anchors, oldest first, each with its MAC verdict; the newest limit (default 1000, at most 10000) with total and truncated. Gated on canAdminister. 503 when the write root is unset.

post.description: Writes a signed audit anchor now and returns {created, anchor}; created is false when nothing was chained since the last anchor. Gated on canAdminister. 409 when events are in memory only or the chain or anchor file does not verify; 429 when called again within the minimum interval; 503 when the write root is unset.

Records the operator's acknowledged break as a signed BREAK anchor with body reason (at most 500 characters) and an audit event; it repairs nothing. Gated on canAdminister. 422 for a missing or over-long reason; 409 when there is nothing to rebaseline or events are in memory only; 429 when repeated within a minute; 503 when the write root is unset.

post.summary: Push NDJSON or CSV records into a Stream's inbox (ASSURE-PUSH-INGEST-1)
post.description: Lands the body as ONE server-named file in the inbox of the Pipeline the Stream's Collector feeds; the ordinary Collector path ingests it. Gated canOperateRuns; per-caller rate limit; optional Idempotency-Key (a replay returns the first result, a concurrent duplicate is 409). Byte cap -Dstreams.push.max_bytes (default 8 MiB), record cap -Dstreams.push.max_records (default 100000). A refusal lands nothing. Not a config write: no write-root gate, no approval hold.

parameters.name: streamId
parameters.description: The Collector id (the id GET /catalog/streams lists).

schema.description: RFC 4180 rows, the Pipeline's delimiter; every row the first row's field count.

201.description: Envelope-wrapped: data = {stream, pipeline, file, records, bytes}. A replay carries Idempotency-Replayed: true.

409.description: pipeline paused (paused or not active), an authoring template, or the same caller's Idempotency-Key still in flight.

413.description: Over the byte or record cap, or a keyed push over the 1 MiB idempotency hash window.

422.description: Not UTF-8, a malformed line (named), no records, or the Pipeline's file_pattern would never ingest the format.

429.description: The caller's push budget is spent.

501.description: A Dataset-fed Pipeline has no inbox.

get.description: Returns the Space's effective Safety Policy, each field naming the tier that constrained it; an unreadable policy file answers readable:false with the reason instead. Gated on canAdminister.

get.summary: Data as of for a Dataset
get.description: The newest value of the Dataset's eventDate column as an ISO-8601 dataAsOf (null with a reason when it cannot be read) plus the verdicts of its freshness Alert Rules; with no write root it answers dataAsOf null. No capability gate; the Dataset's view access applies. 404 for an unknown or shared-away Dataset; 400 for an id the store refuses.

get.summary: Arrivals of an Add data Dataset
get.description: The files the Dataset's import Pipeline took (uploads or inbox drops), newest 200 first, with times, rows read and rejected, the period covered and upload details; a Dataset no import made answers no arrivals and a reason. No capability gate; the Dataset's view access applies. 503 when read-only; 404 for an unknown or shared-away Dataset; 400 for an id the store refuses.

LA-REFERENCE-DETAILS-MORE-1: how many of a Reference's entities appear in the Datasets that hold its Entity Type - counts only, no value. {dataset, entityType, entityTypeLabel?, identifyingColumn, described, datasets:[{dataset, columns, appear, absent}], truncated, reason?}. Read gate only (the Dataset's view permission); unknown or shared-away 404; a Dataset that is not a Reference answers 200 with a reason. Never a count over a column masked for the caller: a Reference whose identifying column is masked answers no counts (reason), a holder's masked columns are not compared.

get.summary: Storage state of an import Dataset
get.description: The Dataset's Parquet file count and bytes, the compaction threshold, the last compaction, compacted and removed arrivals, and its retention policy. Gated on canUploadData. 503 when read-only or the Space has no data directory; 403 when Add data is off; 404 for an unknown Dataset; 409 when it is not an Add data import.

put.description: Body {retention: {days: N} | {arrivals: N} | null}, N from 1 to 100000, applied at the next compaction; Standard and up. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 503 when read-only, without a data directory or on an edition without retention; 403 when Add data is off; 404 for an unknown Dataset; 409 when not an import or an approval policy covers Datasets; 422 for a bad retention.

post.description: Merges the Dataset's arrival files into one, ordered by arrival, whatever the file count, and returns the storage state with the compaction result. Gated on canUploadData. 503 when read-only or the Space has no data directory; 403 when Add data is off; 404 for an unknown Dataset; 409 when it is not an Add data import or is being imported or deleted.

get.summary: Row filter of an import Dataset
get.description: The conditions the import keeps rows by (filter) and the columns a condition may name, with their types. Gated on canUploadData. 503 when read-only or the Space has no data directory; 403 when Add data is off; 404 for an unknown Dataset; 409 when it is not an Add data import or its schema is gone.

put.summary: Edit an import Dataset's row filter
put.description: Body {filter: [{column, op, value | min | max, matchCase?}]} ([] or null keeps every row): rewrites the import Pipeline's where and the entry's importFilter together, for files added from now on. Gated on canUploadData. 503 when read-only; 403 when Add data is off; 404 for an unknown Dataset; 409 when not an import, busy or under an approval policy; 422 for a missing filter or a refused condition.

get.summary: Inbox and feed of an import Dataset
get.description: The Dataset's inbox path, the files waiting there (up to 50 named) and which were already imported, and its feed (uploads, folder or sftp) with the folder-watch state. Gated on canUploadData. 503 when read-only or the Space has no data directory; 403 when Add data is off; 404 for an unknown Dataset; 409 when it is not an Add data import.

put.summary: Keep an import Dataset up to date
put.description: Body {kind: folder|sftp, connection?, every?, readyMarker?}: rewrites the import's Pipeline to a scheduled poll (every defaults to 15m, 1m to 1d) with a stability gate and duplicate skipping, and returns indexJob for the client to save. Standard and up. Gated on canUploadData. 503 on Basic or when read-only; 403 when Add data is off; 404; 409 when not an import, busy or under an approval policy; 422 for bad fields.

delete.summary: Return an import Dataset to manual uploads
delete.description: Rewrites the import's Pipeline back to manual uploads, in every edition, and returns the feed read. Gated on canUploadData. 503 when read-only or the Space has no data directory; 403 when Add data is off; 404 for an unknown Dataset; 409 when it is not an Add data import, is being imported or deleted, or an approval policy covers Pipelines; 422 when the rewritten Pipeline is refused.

put.description: Body {watch: true|false}: toggles polling of the Dataset's inbox every 30 s, importing once every waiting file has settled; answers the feed read. Gated on canUploadData. 503 when read-only or the Space has no data directory; 403 when Add data is off; 404 for an unknown Dataset; 422 for a non-boolean watch, a Reference or a Postgres snapshot; 409 when not an import, already on a schedule or under an approval policy.

get.description: Returns the installed-module topology: each module's id, build and offering roles, state with reasons, whether it is enabled in this Space, what it provides and requires; not-installed known modules; manifest diagnostics; and the Space's inert references. Carries an ETag. No capability gate.

get.summary: The Product's Apps, the Apps installed live, and the trusted signers (PRODUCT-ASSEMBLY-1 PA-7d)
get.description: shipped: the build's own Apps; installed: [{id, title, version, signedBy, installedAt, templates}]; signers: the key ids an App package may be signed with (the issuer keys plus conf/app-signers.properties); liveInstall: whether this server is a Product build of a Platform product (a write still needs a Spaces root: 503 without one).

post.summary: Install a signed App package (canAdminister; PA-7d)
post.description: The body is the package zip (tools/inspecto-app.mjs package --key). 503 no Spaces root; 409 not a Platform product build, the App is installed already or ships with the build, or a template collides; 422 a package that does not verify (signature, manifest, an untrusted signer), the App's Platform range, or an Add-on the entitlement leaves out; 423 read-only. The answer is the plan (templates and files added, nav) plus installed.

parameters.name: dryRun
parameters.description: true: answer the plan (templates, files, nav, and on an upgrade each Space's offered difference) and change nothing.

put.summary: Upgrade an installed App (canAdminister; PA-7d, D-PA25)
put.description: The body is the new package. Replaces the App's templates and nav (new Spaces get the new version); a Space already made from it is never changed - the answer offers each one its file-by-file difference (new / update / customised / dropped), applied through the normal config routes. Gates as POST /apps, plus 404-as-409 when not installed.

delete.description: Takes the App's templates (only those it installed) and nav away. Spaces made from it keep every file and are named in spacesKept. 400 when {id} is not an App id; 404 when not installed live (an App the build ships is not removed here).

get.description: Returns {disabled, inert, installed, unreadable}: the feature ids switched off in this Space, stored ids no installed module declares, every installable feature id, and whether the document is unreadable. No capability gate.

put.description: Replaces the Space's disabled feature list with body disabled and audits before and after; a disabled module's routes then answer 404 MODULE_DISABLED. Gated on canAdminister. 422 for an unknown key, a non-list, more than 200 entries or an id that is not a feature of an installed module; 503 when the write root is unset.

post.description: Acknowledges a stored Alert by the id GET /alerts returns, attributed to the caller (or body actor on Basic). Gated on canWorkIncidents. 404 for an unknown Alert; 422 when its state does not allow it; 503 when the alert engine is unavailable.

Resolves a stored Alert by the id GET /alerts returns, attributed to the caller (or body actor on Basic). Gated on canWorkIncidents. 404 for an unknown Alert; 422 when its state does not allow it; 503 when the alert engine is unavailable.

post.summary: Add data: upload a file and get a draft of how to import it
post.description: LA-ONBOARD-1 OB-2. Raw file body; stored in the Space's draft area (data root, _onboard/), never in config. Answers the DRAFT: {draftId, kind, file:{name, bytes, rows}, format:{type, delimiter?, header?, quote? (CSV / TSV), decimalMark? (every text format), recordPath?, flatten? (JSON / NDJSON), fileDate:{value, format, name, evidence, confidence}}, columns:[{name, header, type:{value, format, evidence, confidence}, sample}], rows (first 20), entityTypes:{columns:[{column, entityType:{value, classification?, evidence, confidence}, role:{value (entity|temporal|measure|dimension|detail), evidence, confidence}, distinct? (text columns)}], primary, link:{from, to, kind, primaryTime, primaryMeasure, details} (stream) | identifying (reference)}, limits:{maxBytes, maxRows, maxImports, imports, inlineMaxBytes, excel}, followOns:[{key, does, needs}] (BASIC-ONBOARD-1: each installed application's follow-on step; empty when none, and the import ends at its Parquet)}. Every proposed choice is {value, evidence, confidence: high|low}; OF-2: high when every sampled value agrees and the sample has at least 200 non-blank values. ONBOARDING-FIRST-RUN-1 C1: decimalMark '.' or ',' (a column whose numbers need it is typed as a number and read through it at commit); a JSON document's records are found in its first list of objects (recordPath, the engine's json.records_path) and nested objects are spread into dotted columns (flatten; a list stays JSON text); fileDate is the date the file name holds, and a commit with no name takes fileDate.name (sales_2026-10.csv -> sales). ONBOARDING-FIRST-RUN-1 C2: findings:[{entry (decimal_mark|date_format|delimiter|header_row|encoding|quote|missing_column), column?, cause, fix:{label, redraft?:{param: value} | columns?:[{name, type, format}] | newDataset?}}], the fix catalogue; a file that is not UTF-8 is 422 with error.details.findings (fix: ?encoding=latin-1). Formats (DT-8): CSV, TSV, Parquet, JSON (array), NDJSON; Excel (.xlsx) only when the bundle carries the DuckDB excel extension, else 422 'save as CSV'. Gates in order: capability (canUploadData) 401/403; 503 no write root; 403 when the Space's data.self_import is off (GET /settings/data); 422 name missing/unusable; 403 a path-shaped name; 413 over import.max_bytes (streamed, never buffered) or more rows than import.max_rows; 422 empty, unreadable or unsupported file. Drafts expire after 24 hours. LA-FULL-CYCLE-TEST-1: a text column whose sampled values are almost all numbers, dates or dates with a time (at least nine in ten, and at least ten) is proposed as that type at low confidence, its evidence naming a value that does not fit; the import leaves such values blank and counts them (the commit's blanked). An entityType choice also carries label, the Entity Type's label.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The file's name (bare; its extension selects the reader)

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: stream (events, links; default) or reference (details about entities)

parameters.name: delimiter
parameters.description: Delimited text only: the user's own delimiter (re-draft after a low-confidence proposal)

parameters.name: header
parameters.description: Delimited text only: true or false

parameters.name: quote
parameters.description: Delimited text only: one character, or empty for none

parameters.name: decimal
parameters.description: Text formats only (not Parquet): the decimal mark, '.' or ','

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.description: Delimited text only: utf-8 (default), latin-1 or utf-16 (the encoding fix)

parameters.name: recordPath
parameters.description: JSON only: the dotted path of the list holding the records (one the draft found)

post.summary: Add data: one confirm - write the import Pipeline, run it once, register the Dataset
post.description: LA-ONBOARD-1 OB-2/OB-3/OB-4/OB-8. {fileId} is the draftId. Body (every key optional; absent = the draft's proposal): {name (Dataset and Pipeline id, lower-case), description, columns:[{name (the draft column), type?, format?, entityType? (id or null), role? (entity|temporal|measure|dimension|detail), rename?, drop?}], primaryEntityType?, recordType? (a record type of the Space's packs, or null), link?:{from, to, kind?, primaryTime?, primaryMeasure?, details?[]} | null (stream), eventDate? (stream: its Time column, kept with no link; must equal link.primaryTime when both are given; absent = the link's primaryTime, else, when link is absent too, the draft's proposed Time), identifyingColumn? (reference), format? (must equal the draft's: re-draft to change it)}. A DATE or TIMESTAMP type stated here with no format gets the format most of the column's values are written in (the draft's file is read once more); POST /onboard/files/{draftId}/redraft answers the same before the commit. Writes imports/<id>_schema.toon (index selectors for delimited files) and imports/<id>_pipeline.toon (an ordinary Pipeline, origin: import, trigger {type: manual}, local inbox, accepts_upload, PARQUET), both through the save gate; registers it, lands the file, runs it once, registers the Dataset {physicalRef <id>/database, origin import, kind, columns[].classification, primaryEntityType, defaultLinkMapping, eventDate, identifyingColumn}, then - inside the same run (DT-16), in every edition - builds the link index and evaluates the Expectations targeting the Pipeline. Answers the run summary {dataset, pipeline, kind, file, rowsIn, rowsRejected, blanked:[{column, type (the Dataset column type), values, example}] (LA-FULL-CYCLE-TEST-1: values present in the file that the column's type could not read - each left blank, its row kept; counted before the run with the engine's own cast), unlinked?:{rows, noFrom, noTo, from, to} (a Dataset with a link: rows kept that cannot be a link because an end is blank), respelled?:[{column, values, example, readAs}] (per Entity column: values that are a second spelling of an entity already there, differing only by spaces or letter case; readAs is the key the Entity Type's normaliser gives the example - the link index keeps each spelling as its own node id), rejectedDetail?, quarantined:[{file, reason}], rowsBefore, rowsAfter, rowsChanged, replaced, index:{result, message, code?, edges?, nodes?} (only where Link Analysis registered its link index as a follow-on; each installed application's follow-on reports under its own key, BASIC-ONBOARD-1), expectations:[{name, status, violations}]}; above import.inline_max_bytes 202 {runId, dataset, action, state, startedAt, poll}. A failed commit leaves nothing behind (config files, registration, data and inbox directories, Dataset entry); the draft keeps its file. Gates in order: capability (canUploadData) 401/403; 503 no write root; 403 when the Space's data.self_import is off (GET /settings/data); 404 unknown/expired draft (or another person's); 409 the name is taken (Dataset, Pipeline, config files or data directory), an approval policy holds Datasets, the same import is in flight, or import.max_datasets is reached; 422 a choice naming nothing real, a save-gate refusal, or a run that imported nothing.

default.description: Envelope-wrapped run summary (200) or followed-run record (202).

get.summary: Follow an import run answered with 202
get.description: canUploadData. {runId, dataset, action (commit|add-file), state (running|succeeded|failed), startedAt, finishedAt?, summary? (as the 200 commit), message? (why it failed - everything was undone)}. In memory, the last 200 runs; 404 unknown, evicted, or another person's run (unless canAdminister).

post.summary: Add data, Choose a table: test a Postgres connection and list its tables
post.description: BASIC-ONBOARD-1 P3, every edition. Body {connection:{host, port? (5432), database, user, password}}; password MUST be a secret reference ${ENV:NAME} (the server's environment variable), never the value - it is resolved only to connect and is never answered, stored or logged. Reads through DuckDB's postgres extension, attached READ_ONLY. Answers {connected, user, readOnly:true, tables:[{schema, table, view}] (at most 500), truncated}. Gates in order: capability (canUploadData) 401/403; 503 no write root; 403 data.self_import off; 422 a malformed connection or a raw password; 422 the reference is not set on the server, the database refused the connection (its reason, password scrubbed), or the role could write (superuser, or INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE on any non-system table).

post.summary: Add data: answer a draft again around the column types and roles the person stated
post.description: LA-FULL-CYCLE-TEST-1 phase 3 (finding 4). {fileId} is the draftId. Body {columns:[{name (the draft column), type? (VARCHAR|BIGINT|DOUBLE|DATE|TIMESTAMP|BOOLEAN), role? (temporal|measure|dimension|detail)}]}: every type and role the person stated on screen, the whole set each time (an empty list states nothing). Reads the draft's file again with the format choices the draft was made with and answers the same DRAFT as POST /onboard/files, with the same draftId: a stated type is taken as given at high confidence, its evidence says how many sampled values it reads and names one that it does not, and a date type carries the format most values are written in; a stated role is taken as given; every proposal and reason that depends on them (each column's role, the link's kind, primaryTime and primaryMeasure) is worked out again. The stored draft is replaced, so the commit starts from what was last answered; nothing is written to config. Gates in order: capability (canUploadData) 401/403; 503 no write root; 403 when the Space's data.self_import is off; 404 unknown/expired draft (or another person's), or its file is gone; 422 columns is not a list, an entry names no draft column, or states a type or role outside the lists above (a column is an Entity by its Entity Type, never by a stated role).

post.summary: Add data, Choose a table: copy a Postgres table or query into a draft
post.description: BASIC-ONBOARD-1 P3, every edition. Body {connection (as /onboard/postgres/test), schema + table | query, kind? (stream|reference)}. query must be one read-only SELECT or WITH statement. Copies the rows into Parquet in the draft area (a time-zoned timestamp as its UTC time; types without an import column type as text) and answers the same DRAFT as POST /onboard/files, plus snapshot:{source:postgres, connection (password as its reference), schema, table | query}. Commit with POST /onboard/files/{draftId}/commit: it also writes imports/<id>_snapshot.toon, and Run now (POST /datasets/{id}/run) copies the table again as a replace-everything arrival. Gates as /onboard/postgres/test (the role check runs on every copy, Run now included), then 422 a malformed table/query, an empty result; 413 more rows than import.max_rows.

get.summary: What the onboarding counters say (LA-ONBOARD-1 OB-13)
get.description: canAdminister; with no sign-in anyone. Always on, local, never sent anywhere: {recording, firstLaunch, launches, spacesCreated, firstSpace, firstSpaceSeconds, firstDataset, firstDatasetSeconds, firstGraph, firstGraphSeconds, guideCompleted, guideCompletedSeconds, abandoned {step: count}, abandonedCapReached}. abandonedCapReached is true once a step holds the most abandoned-step lines kept (1000 per step; later reports are dropped). Times are ISO instants, *Seconds count from the first launch; null when it has not happened. recording is false when the server has no document home.

post.summary: Report a step only the browser sees (LA-ONBOARD-1 OB-13)
post.description: Open to any caller, rate-limited (standard bucket). Body {event: guide_completed | step_abandoned, step?} with step one of space, data, columns, graph, list, add_data:file, add_data:columns, add_data:create (required for step_abandoned). 422 for any other word; only the two words and a timestamp are kept. guide_completed is written once per installation; step_abandoned at most 1000 times per step (later reports answer 200 and are dropped).

post.summary: Add a file to an imported Dataset and run it
post.description: LA-ONBOARD-1 OB-2, DT-5. Raw file body, ?name=, ?mode= is REQUIRED (UPLOAD-DEFAULTS-1, no silent default; a missing or unknown one is 422 naming the three): replace (the Dataset becomes this file's rows; the old data is restored if the run fails), append (stream imports only), or period (replace the days it covers; needs a When column). ?newColumns=keep (default) keeps a later file's new columns as details of the Dataset (LA-ARRIVAL-NEW-COLUMNS-1: the schema and the Dataset's columns grow; the answer names them in keptColumns) or leave (left out, named in newColumns with newColumnsReason). The file must be the import's format and carry the columns it reads. Lands the file, runs the import Pipeline, then the in-run link index and Expectations (DT-16); answers the run summary with rowsBefore, rowsAfter, rowsChanged and replaced, or 202 above import.inline_max_bytes. Gates in order: capability (canUploadData) 401/403; 503 no write root; 403 when the Space's data.self_import is off (GET /settings/data); 404 unknown Dataset or one the caller cannot see; 403 view-only; 409 not an import Dataset, or an import of it is in flight; 422 name, mode, format or columns; 413 over import.max_bytes.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The file's name (bare)

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: replace, append or period (required; a missing or unknown one is 422)

default.description: Envelope-wrapped run summary (200) or followed-run record (202).

post.summary: Run now: run an imported Dataset's Pipeline over what waits in its inbox
post.description: LA-ONBOARD-1 OB-2, DT-5/DT-16. Runs the import Pipeline once, then builds the link index and evaluates its Expectations inside the same run; answers the run summary. Gates in order: capability (canUploadData) 401/403; 503 no write root; 403 when the Space's data.self_import is off (GET /settings/data); 404 unknown Dataset or one the caller cannot see; 403 view-only; 409 not an import Dataset, or an import of it is in flight.

put.summary: Change which Entity Type one Dataset column holds
put.description: LA-ONBOARD-1 UC-07. canAuthorWorkbench. Body: at most one of {entityType: '<id>' | null} or {classification: '<X>' | null}, and/or (LA-COLUMN-ROLES-1) role (entity|temporal|measure|dimension|detail), unit (a measure's) and carried (false keeps a Time, Measure or Category column off the links and their index; true or null carries it again); null clears each, at least one key. The Dataset is re-assessed on the next Entity profile read. Gates: 401/403; 503 no write root; 404 unknown Dataset or one the caller cannot see; 403 view-only; 409 an approval policy holds Datasets; 422 unknown column or Entity Type, or the entry then breaks the Dataset rules. Answers {dataset, column, classification, entityType?, columns}.

put.summary: Say what one row of a Dataset is (its record type)
put.description: ENTITY-TYPE-CATALOG-1 P2. canAuthorWorkbench. Body {recordType: '<id>' | null}: a record type of the Space's Industry packs (GET /inv/entity-types answers recordTypes), or null to clear it. It only orders the 'what does this column hold' choices: the record type's likely Entity Types first. Gates: 401/403; 503 no write root; 404 unknown Dataset or one the caller cannot see; 403 view-only; 409 an approval policy holds Datasets; 422 recordType missing, not a string or null, or not a record type of this Space. Answers {dataset, recordType}.

get.description: LA-ONBOARD-1 OB-7. {selfImport (stated: true|false|null), selfImportDefault (true with no sign-in, false with sign-in), selfImportInForce}. When in force, Add data (/onboard/files, Add a file, Run now) is open to canUploadData; off, it answers 403. /bootstrap carries selfImport (in force).

put.summary: Turn Add data on or off for the Space
put.description: LA-ONBOARD-1 OB-7. canAdminister. Body {selfImport: true|false|null} (null = the default for who the user is); anything else is 422. Stored as data.toon in the Space's config root (reserved: no import may write it); 503 when writes are disabled.

get.description: UI-CLASSIFICATION-PICKER-1. Answers {items[{class, masked, source, entityType?, label?}]}, sorted by class: every column classification this Space knows, the same list a save refuses an unknown class by (422 ERR_UNKNOWN_CLASSIFICATION). source is sensitive (MSISDN, IMSI, ACCOUNT, PII), entity-type (a class an Entity Type of the Space claims, or the id of one) or not-masked (INTERNAL); entityType and label name the Entity Type that claims the class, when one does. masked says whether a column of the class is masked for a reader who may not reveal it: a sensitive class, a class a masked Entity Type claims, or the id of a masked Entity Type. Read-only and not capability-gated (reads are open to the Space).

X5 (plan 2026-11-17 section 3.7): the drill-down read of one Consignment, wherever it ran. Joins the ingest ledger row (status, member files, park detail; looked up by id), its Step Receipts (consignment_steps, ordered by flush, run, lane, seq; first 500 + stepsTotal), its registered outputs (consignment_outputs, first 200 + outputsTotal), the job runs that read it (downstream, each with its OWN consignmentId through the run_id join of the receipts, else of the registry) and what its own job run read (upstream), and its newest 50 Signals (correlationId = the id). A store that cannot say leaves its key ABSENT and known.<store> false: with Step Receipts switched off (-Dconsignment.steps=false) steps is absent and known.steps is false, never []. Signal messages are served as GET /signals serves them; a receipt's diag.msg has its quoted literals and secrets masked. Every collection is cut in its read and reports its true total (stepsTotal, outputsTotal, membersTotal, upstreamTotal, downstreamTotal). An open read under Space admission, like GET /runs/{name}/batches. 404 when no store knows the id.

get.summary: Every keyed Reference lookup with its last run
get.description: LOOKUP-1: every keyed transform.join (key:, or from:/to: for a range) in the Space's loaded Pipelines: pipeline, step, reference, match and lookedUpBy (the input columns looked up), each with lastRun read from the Step Receipts (the newest receipt of that Pipeline and Step, dry runs excluded): consignmentId, outcome, startedAt, rowsIn, counts (the receipt's diag.counts: lookup.<on>.hit|miss and reference.rows|null_keys|nested_prefixes) and truncated. Counts only, never a value; diag.msg is not served. lastRun is null before the first run; with Step Receipts switched off it is absent and known.lastRun is false. A plain (non-keyed) join is not listed. First 500 + total. An open read under Space admission, like GET /consignments/{consignmentId}.

200.description: The keyed lookups and their last runs.

ConnectionId.name: id
ConnectionId.description: Immutable Connection id (guideline 17: ids never change).

CorrelationId.name: Correlation-ID
CorrelationId.description: Caller-supplied correlation id; the server issues one when absent and always echoes it as a response header. Propagates to events logged during the request.

ComponentType.name: type
ComponentType.description: Writable component type (W3 widened the set with dataset/widget/dashboard; kpi and reconciliation are written through the same route and are validated by POST /validate).

IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatch.description: Conditional GET: when it holds the current ETag the server returns 304.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Optimistic-lock precondition on a write: a stale tag yields 409 CONFLICT_STALE_VERSION.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Dedupe a retryable write: a repeat with the same key replays the first response (with Idempotency-Replayed: true) instead of re-running. ~10 min TTL. Applies to any POST/PUT/DELETE.

Correlation-ID.description: The request's correlation id (issued or echoed). Present on every response, legacy surface included.

ConsignmentTrail.description: One Consignment across every lane (X5, GET /consignments/{consignmentId}). A key a store cannot answer is ABSENT, and known says which stores could: members only with an ingest ledger row, steps only while Step Receipts are on, outputs only with the Consignment registry, upstream and downstream only with the job-run store.

pipeline.description: The ingest ledger's Pipeline, else the receipts' or the registry's producer.

status.description: The ingest ledger row's status, else the newest live job run's status, else null.

lanes.description: The lanes its Step Receipts name, in trail order; ABSENT with steps.

members.description: Its member-file ledger rows, as GET /runs/{name}/files serves them; first 200.

steps.description: Its Step Receipts; first 500. ABSENT when switched off, never [].

outputs.description: Its consignment_outputs rows, as GET /runs/{name}/outputs serves them; first 200.

upstream.description: The Consignments its own job runs (the newest 20) read (X2 sources), each once; first 50.

runId.description: The run of this Consignment that read it.

downstream.description: The job runs that read it, newest first, each with the Consignment that run wrote (null when it left no receipt and no output); first 50.

parked.description: Present only for a PARKED ingest Consignment: the disabled sinks it parked at and their park tables.

known.description: Which stores could answer; false means this install cannot say.

StepReceipt.description: The record one Step leaves for one Consignment on one lane in one attempt (GLOSSARY Step Receipt; X5). At most 1024 bytes of UTF-8 as stored; truncated says something was cut to fit.

runId.description: The job run; empty on the ingest lanes, never null.

step.description: Node id, or the phase on the flat lane.

outlets.description: Rows leaving per outlet: data, reject:<reason>, route:<key>; at most 16.

ref.description: Where the data rests durably: kind outputs, park, rejects or store.

fp.description: 12-hex fingerprint of the data outlet's (name, type) list.

msg.description: At most 240 chars; masked on read.

AuthExchangeRequest.description: The browser-side PKCE artifacts (W6d). The code is one-time; the verifier proves this client started the flow; the redirectUri must equal the one used on the authorize request.

AuthSession.description: The browser-visible half of the session: the short-lived access token only. The refresh token stays in the httpOnly inspecto_rt cookie and never appears in a body.

Envelope.description: The v1 success envelope (design §4). 'permissions' (per-resource capability verbs) joins with the W6 security module — additive.

data.description: The operation's result DTO (object or array).

permissions.description: The authenticated subject's resolved capability grants (W6, guideline 13 — verbs, never roles). Present only when the security module attached a Subject (Standard and Advanced, authenticated request); absent on Basic / anonymous requests.

etag.description: Strong ETag of the resource (= its config contentHash) — lands with W3.

warnings.description: Deprecation and advisory notices (contract-evolution channel, guideline 33).

Links.description: Hypermedia (guideline 12). 'related' is derived from the R1 refs graph (ComponentKind.deriveRefs), never hand-authored — lands with W3.

rel.description: A RefRel edge: binds · tiles · renders · projects · loads · triggers · emits · invokes (additive).

Pagination.description: Uniform pagination metadata (design §7); cursor preferred over offset. Adopted per-context from W3.

Disposition.description: The Disposition ladder (GLOSSARY §9; FindingsSpec.DISPOSITIONS): the outcome an Incident is resolved with, and the default choices of a Case's Findings. Case-insensitive on input, stored upper-case.

ErrorObject.description: The structured v1 error (design §5). 'technicalMessage', 'suggestedAction' and 'documentation' are additive per-route enrichments.

details.description: Route-specific payload, e.g. the 422 findings ({findings: Finding[]}).

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable code catalog — kept in lockstep with com.gamma.spi.auth.ErrorCodes (pinned by ApiContractTest). THROTTLED is gateway-only (WSO2), never emitted by the backend, so it is not listed here.

field.description: Dotted config path the finding anchors to (e.g. processing.schema_file).

Signal.description: One emitted operational fact — the unit of the Signal network (R4; GLOSSARY §8). Events, Alerts and Notifications are projections/consumers of the one signal ledger, never parallel stores. Serves the Signals & Notifications context (streamed as SSE events on /signals/stream when that context lands).

correlationId.description: Ties the signal to the request/run/batch that produced it.

payload.description: Structured detail bag — never row content.

Ref.description: A typed metadata-graph edge (R1: component-model refs).

rel.description: binds · tiles · renders · projects · loads · triggers · emits · invokes (additive).

admission.description: Present, as closed, only on a Space that admits no one but its creator, a holder of canAdminister and a holder of a role its own role table defines. Absent on an open Space.

createdBy.description: The Subject id of the signed-in person who created a closed Space. Present only beside admission.

location.description: Only for a caller holding canAdminister (or with no sign-in): where the Space lives (SPACE-LOCATIONS-1). spaceFolder and dataFolder are absolute; referenced is true for a Space started through <spaces root>/<id>.ref; holdsData is true when its data folder keeps files in data/ or audit/.

integrity.description: GET /spaces only, and only for a caller holding canAuthorWorkbench in that Space (everyone on Basic): the Space lock's counts from the report in memory (LC-4). status computing|ready|disabled|unavailable|failed; broken, duplicates and changedOutside totals only when ready. Details: GET /spaces/{id}/integrity.

pipeline.description: Present when validating a saved file.

config.description: The decoded config map (the same shape /config/write accepts).

frontend.description: The parsing frontend the draft resolves to.

rejectedRows.description: Rows where some non-blank field failed its cast (bounded).

PipelineListRow.description: A GET /pipelines row. A healthy row is the lifted graph summary (name, active, nodeCount, edgeCount, produces, consumes, plus template/displayName/description only when set) and has no loadError key. A broken row carries ONLY name (the file-name stem, since the declared name never parsed), path and loadError.

name.description: The Pipeline id; for a broken row, the file-name stem (orders_pipeline.toon -> orders).

path.description: Broken rows only: the registered Pipeline file.

loadError.description: Broken rows only: why the file did not load.

file.description: The file the loader refused — a referenced schema/segment/grammar file when the message names one, else the Pipeline file.

line.description: 1-based line the message names; absent when it names none.

ConnectionProfile.description: Secret-masked wire shape (ConnectionProfile.toMap). Secrets are '${ENV:…}' references at rest and '***' on the wire; the '***' sentinel on write preserves the stored reference.

password.description: Always the mask ('***') on the wire.

options.description: Connector options; secret-looking keys are masked.

Component.description: A registry component: identity + W3 version metadata + its config content.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical content (= the ETag payload; matches the UI bundle-v2 hash).

content.description: The component's config (name stamped to match the id).

Bootstrap.description: The platform bootstrap aggregate — backend-owned only; the frontend registries (ComponentKind/VizType/$-params/theme) are excluded by design and merged client-side.

edition.description: The edition (LA-EDITIONS-1 ED-2): basic (auth-free), standard (an Authenticator), advanced (+ the policy engine). Preview reports as advanced.

version.description: The running product's version, read from the fat JAR's manifest (Implementation-Version, stamped by inspecto/pom.xml), or "dev" for an unstamped target/classes run. HOME-VERSION-1, 2026-09-15.

investigations.description: True only when the Link Analysis Investigation surface is installed AND included in this edition AND the install holds the Investigations add-on (false on Basic, the Link Analysis explorer, and on an install with -Daddons.laInvestigations=false: its Investigation routes answer 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE). LA-EDITIONS-1 phase 3, LA-ONBOARD-1 OB-5.

loopbackOnly.description: True only when -Dcontrol.bind narrows the listener to a loopback address. UIE-9, 2026-09-25.

laLevel.description: The Link Analysis level (LA-ONBOARD-1 OB-5): investigations when features.investigations is true, else explorer. It decides the screens; the edition keeps deciding governance.

featureReasons.description: featureId → one short line saying why that feature is locked and which edition or add-on has it (LA-ONBOARD-1 OB-10). Entries only for withheld features (the route features investigations, geoMap and entityPages; the DATA-TIERS-1 screen gates pipelineAutomation, pipelineTransform, pipelineEgress and remoteSystems, under their features key; and - PRODUCT-ASSEMBLY-1 PA-7a - every feature only modules the install's signed entitlement leaves out provide, as 'Not in this installation's entitlement.'); a present feature has none.

entitlement.description: PRODUCT-ASSEMBLY-1 PA-7a/7b: the install's signed entitlement. Every signed-in caller gets installed, state (none | ok | expiring | grace | read-only, D-PA24), readOnlyFrom (the first read-only day) and reason (why read-only). An administrator (canAdminister; everyone without sign-in) also gets forAdministrator: true, id, customer, title, product, edition, apps, addons, nodes (recorded, not enforced), notBefore, expires (null = never), daysLeft (null = never), keyId and problem (a renewed file that was not taken; the last verified one stays in force). While state is read-only, every write answers 423 ENTITLEMENT_READ_ONLY.

configSpecs.description: type → ConfigSpec, one entry per ConfigSpecs.TYPES.

product.description: The Product this server was built as (PRODUCT-ASSEMBLY-1 PA-3), read from the bundle's lib/product.json; null when the build carries none (a target/classes run, a bundle built before PA-3). id, title, shape, host and brand are pre-sign-in context like branding; apps and nav appear only where the Space roster does (signed in, or no Authenticator).

host.description: The single-page application the bundle ships (inspecto-ui/projects/<host>).

apps.description: The Product build's Apps. installed: every module the App needs is ACTIVE (the set GET /modules reports), else missing names them. enabled: installed and none of those modules is switched off in this Space (modules.toon), else switchedOff names them. Only an enabled App draws nav.

nav.description: The areas this caller sees, in drawing order: an entry of an installed App whose feature (if any) is true in this response's features and, where an Authenticator is active, whose capability (if any) the caller holds. path is relative to where the host mounts the App.

parameters.description: Caller values for the query's declared $-parameters (name → value), overriding declared defaults.

QueryRunResult.description: The Result Set contract (design §6.2): rows never travel alone — they come with a typed descriptor, statistics, candidate renderings and export options.

renderings.description: Coarse server-side candidates (table/kpi/line-chart/bar-chart/heatmap); the UI's recommend() refines.

JobRun.description: One job execution (W5): live (RUNNING) or terminal.

status.description: RUNNING, then terminal SUCCESS / FAILED / SKIPPED.

PipelineRun.description: One manual pipeline run (W5b): live (RUNNING) or terminal.

status.description: RUNNING, then terminal SUCCESS / FAILED / CANCELLED (the host closed mid-run and nothing genuinely failed; inputs stay in the inbox).

rejects.description: Set only on a finished DRY run (EXECUTION-RESIDUALS X4): one entry per member that rejected records; empty when none did; null for a real or failed run.

DryRunMemberRejects.description: One dry-run member's rejected records, read from its reject sidecar before the scratch root was deleted. The raw line is deliberately not carried.

rejects.description: The first 100 records, in file order.

KpiWindow.description: A KPI period in the KPI's zone: `from` inclusive, `to` EXCLUSIVE (a month read on the 13th is from the 1st to the 14th).

KpiBands.description: RAG bands. Direction up/down: two thresholds — up is green at or above `green`, amber at or above `amber` (amber <= green); down mirrors it. Direction band: two [lo, hi] intervals, the green one inside the amber one. Outside amber is RED.

KpiDefinition.description: The content of a `kpi` registry component (KpiDefinition.fromMap validates it fail closed; an unknown key other than `x-*` is a 422).

measure.description: count, or agg(field) with agg one of MeasureCompiler.AGGS.

timeField.description: The DATE / TIMESTAMP / TIMESTAMPTZ column a period is cut on.

timezone.description: An IANA region zone (e.g. Asia/Kolkata); offset forms are refused. Absent: UTC.

asOf.description: Opt in to a period that follows the data: `latest` evaluates as of the newest day present in `timeField` (never past today) when the request carries no `asOf`. Absent: today. Anything else is a 422.

requirement.description: The kpi Requirement this KPI was created from (POST /requirements/{id}/kpi).

RequirementKpiRequest.description: POST /requirements/{id}/kpi body — what only a Builder knows. Merged over what the Requirement supplies (title, target, unit, direction from its comparator); body keys win. `dataset`, `measure`, `timeField` and `grain` are required of the merged KPI, and the Requirement supplies none of them.

id.description: The KPI id. Default: the Requirement's id.

direction.description: Overrides the direction read off the Requirement's comparator.

KpiValue.description: GET /kpis/{id}/value. Every key is always present; the nullable ones are null when there is nothing to report (no rows, comparison `none`, no target or bands).

timezone.description: The zone the periods were cut in (the region id `UTC` by default).

comparisonPeriod.description: The same elapsed length of the comparison period; null for comparison `none`.

deltaPct.description: (value - comparisonValue) / |comparisonValue| × 100; with a zero comparison value it is 0 when the value is also 0, else null.

tone.description: The band as a statusTone word; neutral when there is no band.

ReconBreakSet.description: One paged Break set of POST /recon/breaks.

ReconBreak.description: One Break at the key-column grain. `a` = anchor, `b` = compared side; a missing_right row carries `a` only, a missing_left row `b` only.

a.description: The anchor's compared values by column (plus `__records` when the record count is compared).

b.description: The compared side's values, shaped like `a`.

impact.description: Present only when `impact.column` is NOT a compare column: that column's per-side value (SUM per key, cast to DOUBLE), carried and never compared. A side absent at the key, or whose Dataset lacks the column, is null.

PendingChange.description: A Pending Change without its content — what the list, and every decision, returns.

kind.description: The Approval Policy kind (config type or component kind).

name.description: The target's name within its kind.

status.description: `pending` until decided; `approved` (applied), `declined`, `withdrawn` (by its author), `expired`, `stale` (its base moved) are terminal; `invalid` = the record's MAC does not verify.

author.description: The Subject id that proposed it.

authorCapabilities.description: For the reviewer only — apply re-resolves the author's roles as they are then.

baseVersion.description: Content hash of what it replaces; `absent` for a create.

proposedVersion.description: Content hash of what it writes; `absent` for a delete.

decidedBy.description: Who closed it — the approver, decliner, the author on a withdraw, `system` on expiry.

mac.description: HMAC-SHA256 over the record, keyed outside the config tree.

integrity.description: Present only when the MAC does not verify.

current.description: The content it replaces; null for a create.

proposed.description: The content it writes; null for a delete.

required.description: Whether a change to this kind is held as a Pending Change until approved.

approverCapability.description: The capability an approver must hold; must be one some route demands. Missing or blank falls back to `canApproveChanges`.

fourEyes.description: Whether the approver must be someone other than the author.

failedClosed.description: True when `approval.toon` exists but could not be read — `approval` is then empty and every kind in `governable` is held with the defaults.

governable.description: The kinds a policy may name (read-only).

defaultApproverCapability.description: The approverCapability a rule gets when it names none (read-only).

total.description: Every matching change, however many were returned.

coarse.description: True when the middle was too large to tabulate and is shown as a whole replacement.

reason.description: Recorded as `decisionReason` and on the audit row.

applied.description: True only for an approval that wrote.

result.description: Approve only: the replayed route's own answer.

PathJail.description: A resolved path escapes the write root (PATH_JAIL_VIOLATION). Under Standard and Advanced, 403 also carries PERMISSION_DENIED for authorization denials.

Conflict.description: Resource conflict — duplicate id, in-use referent, or overwrite refused (CONFLICT).

ValidationFailed.description: Spec/safety validation failed (CONFIG_VALIDATION_FAILED); error.details carries the findings.

NotModified.description: Resource unchanged since the client's cached copy (If-None-Match matched the current ETag) — 304, no body.

StaleVersion.description: An If-Match write precondition failed — the resource changed since it was read (CONFLICT_STALE_VERSION); re-read and retry.

Unauthenticated.description: Missing or invalid credentials (UNAUTHENTICATED) — Standard and Advanced only; Basic never emits it.

SessionUnavailable.description: No session broker on this edition (CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE) — the /auth/* routes are live only when the Standard security module is bundled.

oidc.description: Standard and Advanced only (W6): IAM-issued JWT validated by the resource server (issuer/audience/expiry via JWKS); authorization derived from claims → Roles → Capabilities. The Basic edition serves the same contract auth-free on localhost. No operation declares a security requirement until W6 lands.
